verses.kjv: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.modern: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to Him in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of His reign.

verses.kjv: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.modern: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, and continued through the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah — until Jerusalem was carried into captivity in the fifth month.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:

verses.kjv: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.modern: "Before I formed You in the womb I knew You. Before You were born I sanctified You and ordained You a prophet to the nations."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.modern: I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! I do not know how to speak — I am only a child."

verses.kjv: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.modern: But the LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.' You will go to everyone I send You to, and You will speak everything I command You.

verses.kjv: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with You to rescue You," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.modern: Then the LORD reached out His hand and touched my mouth. He said to me, "I have put My words in Your mouth.

verses.kjv: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.modern: See — today I appoint You over nations and kingdoms, to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant."

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me again: "Jeremiah, what do you see?" I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.modern: The LORD said, "You have seen correctly, for I am watching over My word to carry it out."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me a second time: "What do You see?" I said, "I see a boiling pot, tilting away from the north."

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Disaster will break out from the north on all who live in this land.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.modern: For I am calling all the kingdoms of the north," says the LORD. "They will come and each king will set His throne at the entrance of Jerusalem's gates. They will attack all its surrounding walls and all the towns of Judah.

verses.kjv: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.modern: I will pronounce judgment on them for all their wickedness. They have forsaken Me, burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the work of their own hands.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.modern: So prepare Yourself. Stand up and speak to them everything I command You. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify You before them.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.modern: Today I have made You a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land — against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.

verses.kjv: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
verses.modern: They will fight against You but will not overcome You, for I am with You to rescue You," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD called Jeremiah before he was born and ordained him a prophet to the nations. Jeremiah protested that he was only a child, but the LORD touched his mouth and put His words in it. The LORD showed him two visions -- an almond branch and a boiling pot tilting from the north -- and promised to make him a fortified city against the whole land.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:

verses.kjv: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.modern: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: 'This is what the LORD says: I remember Your devotion in Your youth, Your love as a young bride — how You followed Me through the desert, through a land not sown with crops.

verses.kjv: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of his harvest. All who devoured Israel were held guilty, and disaster came on them,'" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
verses.modern: Hear the word of the LORD, You house of Jacob — all you families of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "What fault did Your ancestors find in Me, that they strayed so far? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

verses.kjv: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.modern: They did not ask, 'Where is the LORD Who brought us up from Egypt? He led us through the desert, through a land of dry wasteland and deep darkness, through a land no one travels and no one lives in.'

verses.kjv: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
verses.modern: I brought You into a fertile land to enjoy its fruit and good things. But when You entered, You defiled My land and made My inheritance detestable.

verses.kjv: The priests said not, Where is the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.modern: The priests did not ask, 'Where is the LORD?' Those who handled the law did not know Me. The leaders rebelled against Me. The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed useless things.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
verses.modern: "Therefore I will bring charges against You," says the LORD. "I will bring charges against Your grandchildren too.

verses.kjv: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing:
verses.modern: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and look. Send to Kedar and observe closely. See if anything like this has happened:

verses.kjv: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
verses.modern: Has any nation ever changed its gods — even though they are not real gods at all? Yet My people have exchanged their Glory for something that has no value.

verses.kjv: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Be shocked at this, You heavens! Shudder with great horror," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.modern: "My people have committed two sins: They have abandoned Me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns — broken cisterns that hold no water.

verses.kjv: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
verses.modern: Is Israel a slave? Was He born into slavery? Why then has He become plunder?

verses.kjv: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.modern: Lions have roared at Him and raised their voices. They have ruined His land. His cities are burned down with no one living in them.

verses.kjv: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have fed on the crown of thy head.
verses.modern: Also the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of Your head.

verses.kjv: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
verses.modern: Have You not brought this on Yourself by forsaking the LORD Your God when He led You in the way?

verses.kjv: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.modern: Now why go to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?

verses.kjv: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.modern: Your own wickedness will punish You. Your unfaithfulness will correct You. Know and see how evil and bitter it is to forsake the LORD Your God and to have no fear of Me," says the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.kjv: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.modern: "Long ago I broke Your yoke and tore off Your chains. You said, 'I will not serve idols.' Yet on every high hill and under every green tree You lay down and played the harlot.

verses.kjv: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.modern: I planted You as a choice vine — all good stock. How then have You turned into a corrupt, wild vine?

verses.kjv: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: Even if You scrub Yourself with lye and use plenty of soap, the stain of Your iniquity is still before Me," says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.modern: How can You say, 'I am not defiled — I have not followed the Baals'? Look at what You did in the valley. Know what You have done. You are a swift young camel running back and forth,

verses.kjv: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.modern: a wild donkey at home in the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving. Who can hold her back when she is in heat? Any male that seeks her will find her easily in her season.

verses.kjv: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.modern: Keep Your feet from going bare and Your throat from thirst. But You said, 'It is no use! I love foreign gods and must go after them.'

verses.kjv: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
verses.modern: As a thief is shamed when caught, so the house of Israel is shamed — their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets.

verses.kjv: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.modern: They say to wood, 'You are my father,' and to stone, 'You gave birth to me.' They have turned their backs to Me and not their face. Yet when they are in trouble, they say, 'Come and save us.'

verses.kjv: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
verses.modern: Where then are the gods You made for Yourself? Let them come if they can save You when You are in trouble. For You have as many gods as You have cities, O Judah.

verses.kjv: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Why do You bring charges against Me? You have all rebelled against Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.modern: I struck Your people in vain — they accepted no correction. Your sword has devoured Your prophets like a destroying lion.

verses.kjv: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
verses.modern: You of this generation, listen to the word of the LORD. Have I been a desert to Israel? A land of deep darkness? Why do My people say, 'We are free to roam — we will come to You no more'?

verses.kjv: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.modern: Does a young woman forget her jewelry? Does a bride forget her wedding clothes? Yet My people have forgotten Me for more days than can be counted.

verses.kjv: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
verses.modern: How skilled you are at chasing love! You have even taught the wicked women your ways.

verses.kjv: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.modern: On your clothes is found the blood of the innocent poor. You did not catch them breaking in — yet in spite of all this

verses.kjv: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from him. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
verses.modern: you say, 'I am innocent. Surely His anger has turned away from me.' But I will judge you because you say, 'I have not sinned.'

verses.kjv: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
verses.modern: Why do you run here and there, changing your alliances? You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you were disappointed by Assyria.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.modern: You will leave that place with Your hands on Your head, for the LORD has rejected those You trust. You will not succeed with their help.

chapters.summary: The LORD recalled Israel's early devotion as a young bride who followed Him through the wilderness. He charged them with forsaking the fountain of living waters and hewing out broken cisterns that can hold no water. Israel's own wickedness would correct her, for she had committed two evils -- forsaking the LORD and turning to worthless idols.

verses.kjv: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: God says: "If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, can He take her back? Would not that land be completely defiled? But You have committed adultery with many partners — yet return to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
verses.modern: Look up at the bare heights and see: where have You not been lain with? You sat by the roadside waiting for lovers, like an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with Your whoredoms and with Your wickedness.

verses.kjv: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.modern: Therefore the spring rains have been withheld and the late rains have not come. Yet You have a whore's forehead — you refuse to be ashamed.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
verses.modern: Have You not just now called to Me, 'My Father, You are the friend of my youth'?

verses.kjv: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
verses.modern: 'Will God be angry forever? Will He be angry to the end?' You say this, but You keep on doing evil."

verses.kjv: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
verses.modern: In the days of King Josiah the LORD said to me: "Have You seen what backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree and played the harlot there.

verses.kjv: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.modern: After she had done all this, I said to her, 'Return to Me.' But she did not return. Her unfaithful sister Judah saw this.

verses.kjv: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.modern: I saw that because backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorce. Yet her treacherous sister Judah had no fear — she also went and played the harlot.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.modern: Through the lightness of her whoredom she defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

verses.kjv: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Even after all this, her unfaithful sister Judah has not returned to Me with her whole heart — only in pretense," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

verses.kjv: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.
verses.modern: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: 'Return, faithless Israel,' says the LORD. 'I will not look on You in anger, for I am merciful,' says the LORD. 'I will not be angry forever.

verses.kjv: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Only acknowledge Your iniquity — that You have rebelled against the LORD Your God and scattered Your favors among foreign gods under every green tree, and that You have not obeyed Me,'" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.modern: "Return, faithless children," says the LORD, "for I am Your master. I will take You — one from a city, two from a family — and bring You to Zion.

verses.kjv: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.modern: Then I will give You shepherds after My own heart, who will lead You with knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
verses.modern: In those days, when You have multiplied and grown in the land," says the LORD, "people will no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the LORD.' It will not come to mind or be remembered or missed. It will not be made again.

verses.kjv: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.modern: At that time Jerusalem will be called the throne of the LORD. All nations will gather there in the name of the LORD. They will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

verses.kjv: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.modern: In those days Judah and Israel will come together from the land of the north to the land I gave Your ancestors as an inheritance.

verses.kjv: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
verses.modern: I said, 'How gladly would I treat You like a son and give You a pleasant land — the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.' I thought You would call Me 'My Father' and never turn away from Me.

verses.kjv: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But like a woman who is unfaithful to her husband, you have been unfaithful to Me, Israel," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.
verses.modern: A sound is heard on the bare heights — the weeping and pleading of the children of Israel, because they have twisted their way and forgotten the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
verses.modern: "Return, faithless children — I will heal Your unfaithfulness." "We come to You, for You are the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.modern: Truly the noise from the hills is a deception. Truly the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

verses.kjv: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.modern: From our youth the shameful idol has consumed what our fathers worked for — their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
verses.modern: Let us lie down in our shame and let our dishonor cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God — we and our ancestors — from our youth until now. We have not obeyed the LORD our God."

chapters.summary: The LORD compared Israel to a wife who has played the harlot with many lovers and yet asks to return. He called faithless Israel and treacherous Judah to repent, promising to give them shepherds after His own heart. He declared that in those days they will no longer speak of the ark of the covenant, for Jerusalem itself will be called the throne of the LORD.

verses.kjv: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
verses.modern: "If You return, Israel," says the LORD, "then return to Me. If You remove Your detestable idols from My sight, You will not wander away.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.modern: You will swear, 'As the LORD lives' — in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. Then the nations will praise themselves by him, and in him they will boast."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: "Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.

verses.kjv: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.modern: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD and remove the hardness of Your hearts, You people of Judah and Jerusalem. Otherwise My anger will break out like fire and burn with no one to put it out — because of your evil deeds."

verses.kjv: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.modern: "Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem. Sound the trumpet throughout the land and cry out — gather together and say, 'Run to the fortified cities!'

verses.kjv: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.modern: Raise the signal flag toward Zion. Flee for safety — do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, a great destruction.

verses.kjv: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: A lion has come out of His den, a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left His place to lay Your land waste. Your cities will be ruined, left without a single inhabitant.

verses.kjv: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
verses.modern: Because of this, put on sackcloth and mourn and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.modern: "On that day," says the LORD, "the king and the officials will lose heart. The priests will be horrified and the prophets will be stunned."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
verses.modern: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! You have truly deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, 'You will have peace,' when the sword is at our throats!"

verses.kjv: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.modern: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told: "A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward My people — not to winnow or cleanse,

verses.kjv: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.modern: but a full blast from those places. Now I will pronounce judgment against them."

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.modern: He comes up like clouds. his chariots are like a whirlwind. his horses are swifter than eagles. How terrible for us — we are ruined!

verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.modern: Jerusalem, wash the evil from Your heart so You may be saved. How long will You harbor wicked thoughts?

verses.kjv: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.modern: A voice announces from Dan — disaster proclaimed from the hills of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.modern: "Warn the nations. Announce to Jerusalem: 'A besieging army is coming from a distant country, raising their voices against the cities of Judah.'

verses.kjv: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Like guards surrounding a field they close in on her on every side, because she has rebelled against Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
verses.modern: Your own conduct and actions have brought this on You. This is Your punishment — how bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!

verses.kjv: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.modern: My anguish! My anguish! I writhe in pain. My heart is pounding. I cannot be silent, for I have heard the sound of the trumpet — the alarm of war.

verses.kjv: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
verses.modern: Disaster after disaster is proclaimed. The whole land is ruined. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, my shelters in an instant.

verses.kjv: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.modern: How long must I see the battle flag and hear the sound of the trumpet?

verses.kjv: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.modern: "My people are foolish. They do not know Me. They are senseless children with no understanding. They are skilled at doing evil but do not know how to do good."

verses.kjv: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.modern: I looked at the earth — it was empty and formless. I looked at the sky — it had no light.

verses.kjv: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.modern: I looked at the mountains — they were shaking. All the hills were swaying.

verses.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.modern: I looked — there was no one. Every bird in the sky had flown away.

verses.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.
verses.modern: I looked — the fertile land was a desert. Every city was in ruins before the LORD, before His fierce anger.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "The whole land will be desolate, but I will not destroy it completely.

verses.kjv: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.modern: Because of this the earth will mourn and the sky grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent. I have decided and will not turn back."

verses.kjv: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.modern: Every city will flee at the sound of the horsemen and archers. They will go into the thickets and climb among the rocks. Every city will be abandoned and no one will live in them.

verses.kjv: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
verses.modern: You who are ruined, what will You do? Even if You dress in scarlet and put on gold jewelry, even if You paint Your eyes — you make Yourself beautiful for nothing. Your lovers despise You. They want to kill You.

verses.kjv: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.modern: I hear a cry like that of a woman in labor, the anguish of a mother giving birth to her first child — the voice of Daughter Zion gasping for breath and stretching out her hands, saying, "How terrible for me! I am fainting before killers!"

chapters.summary: The LORD called Israel to return and plow up fallow ground, and to circumcise their hearts. Jeremiah saw a vision of the coming destruction from the north -- the whole land laid waste, the cities broken down, and the heavens without light. The LORD declared that the whole land would be desolate, though He would not make a full end.

verses.kjv: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.modern: "Roam through the streets of Jerusalem. Look around and take note. Search the public squares. See if You can find one person who acts justly and seeks truth. If You find one, I will forgive this city.

verses.kjv: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.modern: Even when they say, 'As the LORD lives,' they are swearing falsely."

verses.kjv: O LORD, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.modern: LORD, do Your eyes not look for truth? You struck them but they felt no pain. You crushed them but they refused to be corrected. They made their faces harder than rock and refused to return.

verses.kjv: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
verses.modern: I thought, "These are only the poor and foolish — they do not know the way of the LORD or the law of their God."

verses.kjv: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.modern: So I went to the leaders and spoke to them. They surely know the way of the LORD and the law of their God. But these also had broken the yoke together and snapped off the chains.

verses.kjv: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.modern: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them. A wolf from the desert will destroy them. A leopard will lurk near their cities. Everyone who comes out will be torn to pieces, because their transgressions are many and their rebellion is great.

verses.kjv: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.modern: "How shall I pardon You for this? Your children have forsaken Me and sworn by gods that are not gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.

verses.kjv: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.modern: They are like well-fed, lusty stallions, each one neighing for another man's wife.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.modern: Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not take revenge on a nation like this?

verses.kjv: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD's.
verses.modern: Go through her vineyards and destroy them, but do not make a full end. Strip away her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.

verses.kjv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The house of Israel and the house of Judah have been completely unfaithful to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: They have belied the LORD, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.modern: They have lied about the LORD, saying, "He will do nothing. No disaster will come upon us. We will not see sword or famine.

verses.kjv: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.modern: The prophets are just hot air — the word of God is not in them. Let what they predict happen to them."

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye have spoken this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD God of hosts says: "Because You have spoken this, I will make My words fire in Your mouth, and this people will be the wood it consumes.

verses.kjv: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.modern: I am bringing a distant nation against You, Israel," says the LORD. "It is an enduring nation, an ancient nation, whose language You do not know and whose speech You do not understand.

verses.kjv: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.modern: Their quivers are like open graves. They are all mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fortified cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.modern: They will devour Your harvest and Your food — what Your sons and daughters should have eaten. They will devour Your flocks and Your herds. They will devour Your vines and Your fig trees. With the sword they will destroy Your fortified cities in which You trust.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.modern: "Yet even in those days," says the LORD, "I will not destroy You completely.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
verses.modern: When You ask, 'Why has the LORD our God done all this to us?' you will tell them: 'Just as You abandoned the LORD and served foreign gods in Your own land, so You will serve foreigners in a land that is not Your own.'"

verses.kjv: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.modern: "Announce this to the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:

verses.kjv: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.modern: Listen to this, you foolish and senseless people — you who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.

verses.kjv: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.modern: Do You not fear Me?" says the LORD. "Do You not tremble before Me? I placed the sand as the boundary for the sea — a permanent limit it cannot cross. The waves may toss but they cannot prevail. They may roar but they cannot pass over it.

verses.kjv: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.modern: But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart. They have turned away and left.

verses.kjv: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.modern: They do not say in their hearts, 'Let us fear the LORD our God, Who gives the autumn and spring rains in season and keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.'

verses.kjv: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good from you.
verses.modern: Your iniquities have turned these blessings away. Your sins have kept good things from You.

verses.kjv: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.modern: Among My people are wicked men who lurk like hunters crouching in ambush. They set traps to catch people.

verses.kjv: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.modern: Like a cage full of birds, their houses are full of dishonest gain. They have become great and grown rich.

verses.kjv: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.modern: They have grown fat and sleek. They have surpassed all the limits of evil. They do not defend the rights of the fatherless or plead the case of the needy.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.modern: "Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not take revenge on a nation like this?

verses.kjv: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.modern: Something horrible and shocking has happened in this land:

verses.kjv: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.modern: The prophets prophesy lies. The priests rule by their own authority. And My people love it this way. But what will You do at the end of it all?"

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to search the streets of Jerusalem for one man who executes judgment and seeks truth, and He would pardon the city. But the people had sworn falsely, refused correction, and broken the yoke. Their prophets prophesied lies and the priests ruled by their own power, and Jeremiah asked what would happen in the end.

verses.kjv: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.modern: "Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Run from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa. Raise a signal fire over Beth-haccerem, for disaster looms from the north — great destruction.

verses.kjv: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.modern: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a beautiful and delicate woman.

verses.kjv: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.modern: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her. They will set up their tents around her and each will graze in His own area.

verses.kjv: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.modern: Prepare for war against her! Attack at noon. But we cry, 'How terrible for us — the day is fading and the evening shadows grow long.'

verses.kjv: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.modern: Attack by night and destroy her fortresses!"

verses.kjv: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Cut down her trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished. She is full of oppression.

verses.kjv: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.modern: As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps her evil fresh. Violence and destruction echo through her. Wounds and blows are all I see.

verses.kjv: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.modern: Take warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from You and make You a wasteland — an uninhabited land."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Let them thoroughly glean Israel like a vineyard. Pass Your hand again over the branches, like a grape picker."

verses.kjv: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.modern: To whom can I speak and give warning so they will listen? Their ears are closed — they cannot hear. The word of the LORD has become an offense to them. They find no pleasure in it.

verses.kjv: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.modern: So I am full of the LORD's fury. I am worn out from holding it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together. For husband and wife alike will be taken, the old man and the very aged.

verses.kjv: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Their houses will be turned over to others — their fields and wives too — for I will stretch out My hand against those who live in this land," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.modern: "From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for profit. From prophet to priest, all practice deceit.

verses.kjv: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.modern: They treat my people's wounds as though they were nothing, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace.

verses.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Were they ashamed when they did these detestable things? No — they were not ashamed at all. They did not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen. When I punish them, they will stumble," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths — ask where the good way is — and walk in it. You will find rest for Your souls." But they said, "We will not walk in it."

verses.kjv: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.modern: I appointed watchmen over You and said, "Listen for the sound of the trumpet." But they said, "We will not listen."

verses.kjv: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.modern: Therefore listen, You nations. Take note, you witnesses, of what is happening to them.

verses.kjv: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.modern: Listen, earth: I am bringing disaster on this people — the result of their own scheming — because they have not listened to My words and have rejected My law.

verses.kjv: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.modern: What good to Me is the incense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable. Your sacrifices do not please Me."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "I will put obstacles before this people. Fathers and sons together will stumble over them. Neighbors and friends will perish."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "A people are coming from the land of the north. A great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.modern: They carry bow and spear. They are cruel and have no mercy. Their sound is like the roaring sea. They ride on horses, armed like men for battle against You, Daughter Zion."

verses.kjv: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.modern: We have heard the report and our hands fall limp. Anguish grips us — pain like a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.modern: Do not go out into the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and terror is on every side.

verses.kjv: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.modern: Put on sackcloth, my people, and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

verses.kjv: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.modern: "I have made You a tester and a fortress among my people, so You may observe and examine their ways.

verses.kjv: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.modern: They are all hardened rebels — they go about spreading slander. They are bronze and iron — all of them corrupt.

verses.kjv: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.modern: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead burns up in the fire. The smelter keeps on working in vain — the wicked are not removed.

verses.kjv: Reprobate silver shall men call them; because the LORD hath rejected them.
verses.modern: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them."

chapters.summary: The LORD warned the children of Benjamin to flee from Jerusalem, for evil and destruction were coming from the north. The city was full of oppression, and the people had rejected the LORD's word. From the least to the greatest, everyone was given to covetousness, and the prophets and priests alike dealt falsely, crying 'Peace, peace' when there was no peace.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
verses.modern: "Stand at the gate of the LORD's house and proclaim this message there. Say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, all You people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the LORD.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Reform Your ways and Your actions and I will let You live in this place.

verses.kjv: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
verses.modern: Do not trust in these deceptive words: 'This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD!'

verses.kjv: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.modern: If You truly reform Your ways and Your actions — if You truly administer justice between people —

verses.kjv: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.modern: if You do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if You do not follow other gods to Your own harm —

verses.kjv: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.modern: then I will let You live in this place, in the land I gave Your ancestors forever and ever.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.modern: But look — you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

verses.kjv: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.modern: You steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods You have not known before.

verses.kjv: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.modern: Then You come and stand before Me in this house that bears My name and say, "We are safe!" — so You can go on doing all these detestable things.

verses.kjv: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Has this house, which bears My name, become a den of robbers in Your eyes? I have been watching!" declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.modern: "Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made My name to dwell and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.

verses.kjv: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.modern: And now, because You have done all these things," says the LORD, "and because I spoke to You again and again but You did not listen, and I called You but You did not answer —

verses.kjv: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.modern: therefore I will do to this house which bears My name — the place You trust in, the place I gave to You and Your ancestors — what I did to Shiloh.

verses.kjv: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.modern: I will drive You out of My presence, just as I drove out all Your relatives, all the people of Ephraim."

verses.kjv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.modern: "So do not pray for this people. Do not offer any plea or prayer for them. Do not plead with Me, for I will not listen to You.

verses.kjv: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.modern: Do You not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.modern: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse My anger.

verses.kjv: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.modern: But am I the one they are provoking?" says the LORD. "Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place — on people and animals, on the trees of the field and the crops of the ground. It will burn and not be quenched."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Go ahead and add Your burnt offerings to Your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

verses.kjv: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.modern: For when I brought Your ancestors out of Egypt, I did not speak to them or command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.kjv: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.modern: But this is what I commanded them: 'Obey Me and I will be Your God and You will be My people. Walk in all the ways I command You, so that it may go well with You.'

verses.kjv: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.modern: But they did not listen or pay attention. Instead they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

verses.kjv: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.modern: From the day Your ancestors came out of Egypt until now, I sent My servants the prophets to You day after day.

verses.kjv: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.modern: But they did not listen to Me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.modern: When You tell them all this, they will not listen to You. When You call to them, they will not answer.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.modern: So say to them, 'This is the nation that has not obeyed the LORD its God or accepted correction. Truth has perished — it has vanished from their mouths.'

verses.kjv: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places: for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.modern: Cut off Your hair and throw it away. Take up a lament on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under His wrath."

verses.kjv: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.modern: "The people of Judah have done evil in My eyes," says the LORD. "They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears My name and have defiled it.

verses.kjv: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.modern: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire — something I never commanded, nor did it enter My mind.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.modern: So the days are coming," says the LORD, "when it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no room.

verses.kjv: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.modern: The bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the air and the animals of the earth. No one will drive them away.

verses.kjv: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.modern: I will end the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and groom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become a wasteland."

chapters.summary: The LORD sent Jeremiah to the temple gate to warn the people not to trust in lying words -- 'The temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD' -- while they stole, murdered, committed adultery, and burned incense to Baal. He pointed to Shiloh, where He had set His name before, and destroyed it. He declared He would cast them out of His sight as He cast out Ephraim.

verses.kjv: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.modern: "At that time," says the LORD, "the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be brought out of their graves.

verses.kjv: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.modern: They will be spread out before the sun and the moon and all the stars of the sky — the things they loved and served and followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried but will be like dung on the surface of the ground.

verses.kjv: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: And death will be preferred to life by all the survivors of this evil family who remain in all the places where I have driven them," says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.modern: "Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: When people fall down, do they not get up? When someone turns away, do they not return?

verses.kjv: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.modern: Why then have these people of Jerusalem turned away? Why do they cling to deceit and refuse to return?

verses.kjv: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.modern: I have listened carefully but they do not say what is right. Not one of them repents of their wickedness by asking, "What have I done?" Each one keeps charging ahead like a horse rushing into battle.

verses.kjv: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their migration; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
verses.modern: Even the stork in the sky knows its appointed seasons. The dove, the swift, and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.

verses.kjv: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
verses.modern: How can You say, "We are wise and we have the law of the LORD"? Actually, the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely.

verses.kjv: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
verses.modern: The wise will be put to shame. They will be dismayed and caught. They have rejected the word of the LORD — what kind of wisdom do they have?

verses.kjv: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.modern: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain. From prophet to priest, all practice deceit.

verses.kjv: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.modern: They dress the wound of my people as though it were nothing, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

verses.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Were they ashamed when they committed these detestable acts? No — they felt no shame at all. They did not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen. When they are punished, they will stumble," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.modern: "'I will take away their harvest,' says the LORD. 'There will be no grapes on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken away.'"

verses.kjv: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
verses.modern: Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there, for the LORD our God has doomed us to perish. He has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, but behold trouble!
verses.modern: We hoped for peace but no good has come. We hoped for a time of healing but found only terror.

verses.kjv: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.modern: The snorting of the enemy's horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of their powerful horses. They have come to devour the land and everything in it — the city and all who live there.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I am sending poisonous snakes among You, vipers that cannot be charmed. They will bite You," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
verses.modern: My grief is beyond healing. My heart is sick within me.

verses.kjv: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
verses.modern: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: "Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King not there?" "Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images and their foreign idols?"

verses.kjv: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.modern: "The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."

verses.kjv: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.modern: Since my people are broken, I am broken. I mourn — horror seizes me.

verses.kjv: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.modern: Is there no medicine in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the healing of my people not come?

chapters.summary: The LORD declared that the bones of Jerusalem's kings, priests, and prophets would be spread before the sun and moon they had worshiped. The people refused to return, and even the stork knows her appointed times, but God's people do not know His judgment. Jeremiah wept for the hurt of his people, asking whether there was no balm in Gilead and no physician there.

verses.kjv: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.modern: If only my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears — I would weep day and night for the dead of my people.

verses.kjv: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.modern: If only I had a traveler's shelter in the desert, I would leave my people and go away from them. They are all adulterers — a crowd of traitors.

verses.kjv: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "They bend their tongues like bows to shoot lies. They are not faithful to truth in the land. They go from one evil to another. They do not know Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.modern: "Be on Your guard against Your friends. Do not trust any relative. Every brother is a deceiver and every friend spreads slander.

verses.kjv: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.modern: Friend deceives friend and no one tells the truth. They have trained their tongues to lie. They exhaust themselves with sinning.

verses.kjv: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: You live in the midst of deception. In their deceit they refuse to know Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: "I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?

verses.kjv: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
verses.modern: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. With their mouths they speak peace to their neighbors but in their hearts they set a trap for them.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.modern: Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not take revenge on a nation like this?"

verses.kjv: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.modern: I will weep and wail over the mountains and take up a lament over the wilderness pastures. They are so desolate that no one travels through. The lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds of the air have flown and the animals are gone.

verses.kjv: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins — a haunt of jackals. I will make the towns of Judah desolate with no one living in them."

verses.kjv: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.modern: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been taught by the LORD to declare why the land is ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one passes through?

verses.kjv: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
