verses.modern: The LORD says: "Because they have abandoned My law which I set before them, and have not obeyed Me or followed My law —

verses.kjv: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
verses.modern: instead they have followed the stubbornness of their own hearts and have gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them to do."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "I will feed this people with bitter food and give them poisoned water to drink.

verses.kjv: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.modern: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known. I will pursue them with the sword until I have destroyed them."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Think about this and call for the wailing women to come. Send for the most skillful of them.

verses.kjv: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.modern: Let them come quickly and wail over us, till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.

verses.kjv: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
verses.modern: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: 'We are ruined! We are deeply shamed because we have been driven from the land and our homes have been torn down.'"

verses.kjv: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.modern: Now listen, You women, to the word of the LORD. Open your ears to the words of His mouth. Teach Your daughters how to wail and each one her neighbor how to lament.

verses.kjv: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
verses.modern: "Death has climbed through our windows and entered our palaces. It has cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares."

verses.kjv: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
verses.modern: Say, "This is what the LORD declares: Dead bodies will lie like manure on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper with no one to gather them."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Let not the wise boast of their wisdom. Let not the strong boast of their strength. Let not the rich boast of their riches.

verses.kjv: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But let those who boast boast in this — that they understand and know Me, that I am the LORD, Who exercises mercy, justice, and righteousness on earth. In these I delight," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh —

verses.kjv: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
verses.modern: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."

chapters.summary: Jeremiah wished his head were waters and his eyes a fountain of tears to weep day and night for his slain people. The LORD declared He would scatter them among nations they did not know, because they had forsaken His law. Let not the wise glory in wisdom, nor the mighty in might, nor the rich in riches, but let him who glories glory in knowing the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.modern: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to You, house of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the sky, even though the nations are terrified by them.

verses.kjv: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.modern: For the practices of the nations are worthless. They cut down a tree from the forest — the work of craftsmen with their axes.

verses.kjv: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.modern: They decorate it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.

verses.kjv: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go: be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.modern: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, these idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them — they can do no harm, and they have no power to do good."

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
verses.modern: There is no one like you, LORD. You are great and Your name is great in power.

verses.kjv: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
verses.modern: Who should not fear You, King of the nations? That is what you deserve. Among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

verses.kjv: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.modern: They are all senseless and foolish. Their wooden idols teach nothing but lies.

verses.kjv: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.modern: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What skilled craftsmen make, what goldsmiths fashion — they dress the idols in blue and purple. All of them are the work of skilled people.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.modern: But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God, the eternal King. When He is angry the earth trembles. The nations cannot endure his wrath.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.modern: Tell them this: "These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens."

verses.kjv: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.modern: But God made the earth by His power. He founded the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

verses.kjv: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.modern: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar. He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from His storehouses.

verses.kjv: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.modern: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is shamed by His idol. The images He makes are a fraud — they have no breath in them.

verses.kjv: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.modern: They are worthless, the objects of mockery. When their punishment comes, they will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.modern: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things — including Israel, the tribe of His inheritance. The LORD of hosts is His name.

verses.kjv: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.modern: Gather up Your belongings and prepare to leave the land, You who live under siege.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says: "At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land. I will bring distress on them so they will feel it."

verses.kjv: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.modern: How terrible my wound is! My injury is severe. But I said, "This is my sickness and I must endure it."

verses.kjv: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.modern: My tent is ruined and all its ropes are snapped. My children are gone from me and are no more. No one is left to set up my tent or hang the curtains.

verses.kjv: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.modern: The shepherds are senseless and do not seek the LORD. So they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.

verses.kjv: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.modern: Listen! The report is coming — great commotion from the land of the north. It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.

verses.kjv: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.modern: LORD, I know that people's lives are not their own. It is not for them to direct their own steps.

verses.kjv: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.modern: Correct me, LORD, but with justice — not in Your anger, or You will reduce me to nothing.

verses.kjv: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.modern: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know you — on the peoples who do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob, consuming him completely and destroying his homeland.

chapters.summary: The LORD warned Israel not to learn the ways of the nations or be dismayed at the signs of heaven. He mocked the idols -- wooden figures overlaid with gold and silver that cannot speak, walk, or do any good or evil. The LORD is the true God, the living God and everlasting King, who made the earth by His power and the world by His wisdom.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.modern: "Listen to the terms of this covenant and speak them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.modern: Tell them this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Cursed is the man who does not obey the terms of this covenant —

verses.kjv: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.modern: the covenant I commanded Your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.' I said, 'Obey Me and do everything I command You. Then You will be My people and I will be Your God.

verses.kjv: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
verses.modern: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to Your ancestors to give them a land flowing with milk and honey — as it is today.'" I said, "Amen, LORD."

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: 'Listen to the terms of this covenant and obey them.

verses.kjv: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.modern: For I warned Your ancestors again and again from the day I brought them out of Egypt until today — warning them earnestly: Obey Me.

verses.kjv: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
verses.modern: But they did not listen or pay attention. Instead they all followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant, which I commanded them to follow but which they did not keep."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.modern: They have returned to the iniquities of their ancestors who refused to listen to My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Though they cry out to Me, I will not listen to them.

verses.kjv: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.modern: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense. But those gods will not save them at all when disaster strikes.

verses.kjv: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.modern: You have as many gods as You have towns, Judah. You have set up as many altars to burn incense to Baal as there are streets in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.modern: So do not pray for this people. Do not offer any cry or prayer on their behalf, because I will not listen when they call to Me in the time of their distress.

verses.kjv: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.modern: What does My beloved have to do in My house when she has done so many wicked things? Can the sacred meat avert Your punishment? When You do evil, You actually rejoice.

verses.kjv: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.modern: The LORD called You a thriving olive tree, beautiful and full of fine fruit. But with a roar of a mighty storm He will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.

verses.kjv: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts, who planted You, has decreed disaster for You, because the house of Israel and the house of Judah have done evil — provoking Me by burning incense to Baal.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.modern: The LORD revealed their plot to me so I knew about it, for at that time You showed me what they were doing.

verses.kjv: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.modern: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter. I did not know they had plotted against me, saying, "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit. Let us cut Him off from the land of the living, so His name will be remembered no more."

verses.kjv: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.modern: But You, LORD of hosts, who judge righteously and test the heart and mind — let me see Your vengeance on them, for to You I have committed my cause.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the men of Anathoth who are seeking Your life and saying, "Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD or You will die by our hands" —

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.modern: this is what the LORD of hosts says: "I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword. Their sons and daughters will die by famine.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
verses.modern: Not one of them will survive, because I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment."

chapters.summary: The LORD reminded Jeremiah of the covenant He made with Israel when He brought them out of Egypt, commanding them to obey His voice. The people of Judah and Jerusalem had broken that covenant and returned to the iniquities of their fathers. The men of Anathoth, Jeremiah's own town, plotted against his life, and the LORD declared He would punish them.

verses.kjv: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.modern: You are always righteous, LORD, when I bring a case before You. Yet I want to speak with You about Your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the treacherous live at ease?

verses.kjv: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.modern: You have planted them and they have taken root. They grow and produce fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.modern: But You know me, LORD. You see me and test my heart's attitude toward You. Drag them away like sheep to be slaughtered. Set them apart for the day of killing.

verses.kjv: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.modern: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field wither? Because of the wickedness of those who live there, the animals and birds have been swept away. Moreover, these people are saying, "He will not see what happens to us."

verses.kjv: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they deal treacherously with thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.modern: "If You have raced with men on foot and they have worn You out, how can You compete with horses? If You stumble in safe country, how will You manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

verses.kjv: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
verses.modern: Even Your own brothers and Your father's family have betrayed You. They have raised a crowd to pursue You. Do not trust them, even when they speak kind words to You."

verses.kjv: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.modern: "I will abandon My house. I will forsake My inheritance. I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.

verses.kjv: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.modern: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest. She roars at Me — so I have rejected her.

verses.kjv: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.modern: My inheritance is like a speckled bird of prey that other birds surround and attack. Come, gather all the wild animals. Bring them to devour.

verses.kjv: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.modern: Many shepherds will ruin My vineyard. They will trample down My field. They will make My pleasant field a desolate wasteland.

verses.kjv: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
verses.modern: It will be made a wasteland — parched and desolate before Me. The whole land will be laid waste because no one takes it to heart.

verses.kjv: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.modern: Over all the barren heights in the desert, destroyers will come, for the sword of the LORD will devour from one end of the land to the other. No one will be safe.

verses.kjv: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.modern: They will plant wheat but harvest thorns. They will wear themselves out but gain nothing. They will be ashamed of their harvests because of the LORD's fierce anger."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "As for all My wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave to My people Israel — I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.modern: But after I have uprooted them, I will again have compassion on them and bring each one back to his own inheritance and his own land.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.modern: And if they learn well the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying 'As the LORD lives' — just as they taught My people to swear by Baal — then they will be established among My people.

verses.kjv: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But if any nation will not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: Jeremiah asked the LORD why the way of the wicked prospers and the treacherous are at ease. The LORD answered that if Jeremiah could not keep up with footmen, how would he run with horses? The LORD declared He had forsaken His house and given His beloved into the hands of her enemies, but He would afterward return and have compassion and bring each nation back to their heritage.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around Your waist, but do not let it touch water."

verses.kjv: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
verses.modern: So I bought the belt as the LORD directed and put it on.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:

verses.kjv: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.modern: "Take the belt You bought and are wearing. Go now to the Euphrates and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks."

verses.kjv: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.modern: So I went and hid it at the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.modern: Many days later the LORD said to me, "Go to the Euphrates now and get the belt I told You to hide there."

verses.kjv: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.modern: So I went to the Euphrates and dug it up. I took the belt from the place where I had hidden it, but it was ruined and completely useless.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.modern: These wicked people refuse to listen to My words. They follow the stubbornness of their own hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them. They will be like this belt — completely useless.

verses.kjv: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.modern: For just as a belt clings to a man's waist, so I bound the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to Myself," says the LORD, "so they would be My people — My fame, My praise, and My glory. But they did not listen."

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.modern: "Tell them this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Every jar should be filled with wine.' They will reply, 'Don't we know very well that every jar should be filled with wine?'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.modern: Then tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: I am going to fill all who live in this land — the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem — with drunkenness.

verses.kjv: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.modern: I will smash them against each other — parents and children alike,' says the LORD. 'I will allow no pity, mercy, or compassion. I will destroy them.'"

verses.kjv: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
verses.modern: Hear and pay attention. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
verses.modern: Give glory to the LORD Your God before He brings darkness, before Your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light but He will turn it to deep darkness and change it to thick gloom.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock is carried away captive.
verses.modern: But if You do not listen, I will weep in secret because of Your pride. My eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the LORD's flock will be taken captive.

verses.kjv: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.modern: Say to the king and to the queen mother: "Humble yourselves and sit down, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads."

verses.kjv: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.modern: The cities of the south shall be shut up with no one to open them. All Judah shall be carried away captive — wholly carried away captive.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
verses.modern: Look up and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you — your beautiful flock?

verses.kjv: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
verses.modern: What will You say when the LORD sets over You those You Yourself taught to be Your allies? Will not pain grip You like that of a woman in labor?

verses.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
verses.modern: And if You ask Yourself, "Why has this happened to me?" — it is because of Your great iniquity that Your skirts have been torn off and Your body violated.

verses.kjv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.modern: Can an Ethiopian change His skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can You do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.modern: "I will scatter You like chaff driven by the desert wind.

verses.kjv: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.modern: This is Your lot — the portion I have decreed for you," says the LORD, "because You have forgotten Me and trusted in false gods.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
verses.modern: I will pull up Your skirts over Your face so Your shame may be seen —

verses.kjv: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
verses.modern: I have seen Your adulteries and Your neighings, the lewdness of Your whoredom and Your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to You, O Jerusalem! Will you not be made clean? When shall it once be?"

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to buy a linen girdle and hide it in a hole by the Euphrates; when he retrieved it, the girdle was ruined. So the LORD would ruin the pride of Judah and Jerusalem. He warned that every bottle would be filled with wine -- a symbol of drunkenness and destruction -- and called the people to give glory to the LORD before He caused darkness.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
verses.modern: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

verses.kjv: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
verses.modern: "Judah mourns and its gates droop. The people sink to the ground in mourning, and the cry of Jerusalem goes up.

verses.kjv: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
verses.modern: The nobles send their servants for water. They go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with empty jars. In shame and misery they cover their heads.

verses.kjv: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
verses.modern: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land. The farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

verses.kjv: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
verses.modern: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.

verses.kjv: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
verses.modern: Wild donkeys stand on the bare heights and pant for air like jackals. Their eyes grow dim because there is no food."

verses.kjv: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
verses.modern: Although our iniquities testify against us, LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Our unfaithfulness has been great. We have sinned against You.

verses.kjv: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
verses.modern: You are the hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress. Why should You be like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who only stays the night?

verses.kjv: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
verses.modern: Why are You like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior who cannot save? You are among us, LORD, and we bear Your name. Do not forsake us!

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says about this people: "They love to wander. They have not held back their feet. So the LORD does not accept them. He will now remember their iniquity and punish their sins."

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not pray for the good of this people.

verses.kjv: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.modern: Even if they fast, I will not listen to their cry. Even if they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead I will destroy them by sword, famine, and plague."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
verses.modern: I replied, "Ah, Lord GOD! The prophets keep telling them, 'You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give You lasting peace in this place.'"

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake I unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "The prophets are prophesying lies in My name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to You false visions, worthless divinations, and the delusions of their own minds.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who are prophesying in My name but whom I did not send — and who say 'No sword or famine will touch this land': Those same prophets will die by sword and famine.

verses.kjv: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
verses.modern: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and the sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters. I will pour on them the calamity they deserve.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
verses.modern: "Speak this word to them: 'Let my eyes flow with tears night and day without stopping, for the virgin daughter of my people has suffered a crushing blow — a very serious wound.

verses.kjv: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
verses.modern: If I go out into the countryside, I see those killed by the sword. If I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they do not know.'"

verses.kjv: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
verses.modern: Have You completely rejected Judah? Do You despise Zion? Why have You struck us down with no healing for us? We hoped for peace but found no good. We hoped for a time of healing but found only terror.

verses.kjv: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
verses.modern: We acknowledge our wickedness, LORD — the iniquity of our fathers — for we have sinned against You.

verses.kjv: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
verses.modern: For the sake of Your name, do not reject us. Do not dishonor Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us — do not break it.

verses.kjv: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
verses.modern: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No — it is You, LORD our God. So our hope is in You, for You are the one who does all this.

chapters.summary: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah concerning the drought. Judah mourned, the ground was parched, and even the deer abandoned their young. The LORD told Jeremiah not to pray for the people's good, and He rejected their fasts and offerings. The prophets who prophesied peace would themselves be consumed by sword and famine.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from My presence! Let them go!

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
verses.modern: If they ask You, 'Where shall we go?' tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: Those destined for death, to death. Those for the sword, to the sword. Those for famine, to famine. Those for captivity, to captivity.'

verses.kjv: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
verses.modern: I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," says the LORD: "the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and the wild animals to devour and destroy.

verses.kjv: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
verses.modern: Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

verses.kjv: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
verses.modern: You have rejected Me," says the LORD. "You keep going backward. So I will reach out My hand and destroy You. I am weary of relenting.

verses.kjv: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
verses.modern: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on My people, for they have not changed their ways.

verses.kjv: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
verses.modern: Their widows will be more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men. Suddenly I will bring on them anguish and terror.

verses.kjv: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day. She will be disgraced and put to shame. As for the survivors, I will hand them over to the sword before their enemies," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
verses.modern: Woe to me, my mother, that You gave birth to me — a man with whom the whole land strives and quarrels. I have not lent or borrowed money, yet everyone curses me.

verses.kjv: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.modern: The LORD said, "Surely I will free You for a good purpose. Surely I will make Your enemies plead with You in times of disaster and distress.

verses.kjv: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
verses.modern: Can a man break iron — iron from the north — or bronze?

verses.kjv: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
verses.modern: Your wealth and Your treasures I will give as plunder without charge — because of all Your sins throughout Your country.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
verses.modern: I will enslave You to Your enemies in a land You do not know, for My anger has kindled a fire that will burn against You."

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.modern: LORD, You understand. Remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are longsuffering — do not take me away. Know that for Your sake I suffer reproach.

verses.kjv: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verses.modern: When Your words came, I received them joyfully. Your word was the joy and delight of my heart, for I bear Your name, LORD God of hosts.

verses.kjv: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
verses.modern: I did not sit in the company of mockers or celebrate with them. Under Your hand I sat alone, because You had filled me with indignation.

verses.kjv: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
verses.modern: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? Will You be to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "If You return, I will restore You and You will stand before Me. If You speak what is precious rather than what is worthless, You will be My spokesman. Let them turn to You — but do not turn to them.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will make You a strong bronze wall to this people. They will fight against You but will not overcome You, for I am with You to rescue and save You," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.modern: "I will save you from the hands of the wicked and rescue you from the hands of the ruthless."

chapters.summary: The LORD declared that even if Moses and Samuel stood before Him, He would not relent toward this people. He appointed four forms of destruction -- the sword, dogs, birds, and beasts. Jeremiah complained of his sorrow, and the LORD promised that if he returned and separated the precious from the worthless, Jeremiah would be as God's mouth and the LORD would save him from the hand of the terrible.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.modern: "You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the mothers who bear them and the fathers who father them:

verses.kjv: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.modern: "They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will lie like dung on the surface of the ground. They will perish by sword and famine. Their bodies will become food for the birds of the air and the wild animals."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn My blessing, My mercy, and My compassion from this people," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
verses.modern: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned. No one will cut themselves or shave their head for them.

verses.kjv: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.modern: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead — not even for a father or a mother. No one will give them a drink to console them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.modern: "And do not enter a house where people are feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to put an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and groom in this place — in Your own lifetime and before Your eyes.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
verses.modern: When You tell these people all this and they ask You, 'Why has the LORD decreed such great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
verses.modern: then say to them, 'It is because Your ancestors forsook Me,' says the LORD, 'and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook Me and did not keep My law.

verses.kjv: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
verses.modern: And You have behaved worse than Your ancestors. Each of You follows the stubbornness of Your evil heart instead of obeying Me.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
verses.modern: So I will throw You out of this land into a land neither You nor Your ancestors have known. There You will serve other gods day and night, for I will show You no favor.'

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.modern: "But the days are coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

verses.kjv: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.modern: but they will say, 'As the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where He had driven them.' For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.modern: "But first I will send for many fishermen," says the LORD, "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down from every mountain and hill and from the crevices in the rocks.

verses.kjv: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
verses.modern: My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from Me, nor is their iniquity hidden from My eyes.

verses.kjv: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.modern: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled My land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and filled My inheritance with their detestable idols."

verses.kjv: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.modern: LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress — the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth and say, "Our ancestors inherited nothing but lies, worthless things with no benefit."

verses.kjv: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
verses.modern: Can people make their own gods? Such things are not gods at all!

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.
verses.modern: "Therefore I will teach them — this time I will teach them My power and My strength. They will know that My name is the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah not to take a wife or have children in this place, because sons and daughters born there would die of deadly diseases. He was not to enter a house of mourning or a house of feasting, for the LORD had taken away His peace, lovingkindness, and mercies from this people. Yet afterward the LORD would bring them back from all the lands where He had driven them.

verses.kjv: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.modern: "The sin of Judah is engraved with an iron tool — inscribed with a flint point on the tablet of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

verses.kjv: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.modern: Even their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

verses.kjv: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.modern: My mountain in the open country — I will give away Your wealth and all Your treasures as plunder, along with Your high places, because of sin throughout Your land.

verses.kjv: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
verses.modern: You will lose the inheritance I gave You. I will enslave You to Your enemies in a land You do not know, for You have kindled My anger, and it will burn forever."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Cursed is the one who trusts in man — who depends on human strength and whose heart turns away from the LORD.

verses.kjv: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.modern: That person will be like a bush in the desert. They will not see prosperity when it comes. They will live in the parched wilderness, in a salt land where no one lives.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
verses.modern: But blessed is the one who trusts in the LORD, whose hope is in the LORD.

verses.kjv: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.modern: That person is like a tree planted by the water. It sends out its roots by the stream and does not fear when heat comes. Its leaves stay green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit.

verses.kjv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.modern: The heart is more deceitful than anything else and desperately wicked. Who can understand it?

verses.kjv: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.modern: I the LORD search the heart and test the mind, to reward each person according to their conduct — according to what their deeds deserve.

verses.kjv: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.modern: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay is the person who gains riches by unjust means. When their life is half gone, their riches will desert them. In the end they will be shown to be a fool.

verses.kjv: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.modern: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning — that is the place of our sanctuary.

verses.kjv: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
verses.modern: LORD, You are the hope of Israel. All who forsake You will be put to shame. Those who turn away from You will be written in the dust, for they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living water.

verses.kjv: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verses.modern: Heal me, LORD, and I will be healed. Save me and I will be saved, for You are the one I praise.

verses.kjv: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.
verses.modern: They keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!"

verses.kjv: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
verses.modern: I have not run away from being Your shepherd. I have not desired the day of disaster. You know what passed my lips was said in Your presence.

verses.kjv: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
verses.modern: Do not be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of disaster.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.modern: Let those who persecute me be put to shame, but keep me from shame. Let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster — destroy them with double destruction.

verses.kjv: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah come and go. Then stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.modern: Say to them: 'Hear the word of the LORD, You kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone who comes through these gates.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.modern: Do not carry a load out of Your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded Your ancestors.

verses.kjv: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.modern: Yet they did not listen or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and would not listen or accept correction.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.modern: But if You are careful to obey Me," says the LORD, "and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it —

verses.kjv: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.modern: then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials — in chariots and on horses. The people of Judah and Jerusalem will come, and this city will be inhabited forever.

verses.kjv: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: People will come from the cities of Judah and from the places about Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, meat offerings and incense, and sacrifices of praise to the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.modern: But if You do not listen to Me and keep the Sabbath day holy — if You carry loads through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath — then I will set fire to its gates. It will consume the palaces of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.'"

chapters.summary: The LORD declared that the sin of Judah was written with a pen of iron and engraved on the tablet of their heart. Cursed is the man who trusts in man, but blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, for he shall be like a tree planted by the waters. The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked -- who can know it? The LORD searches the heart and tests the mind.

verses.kjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.modern: "Go down to the potter's house, and there I will give You My message."

verses.kjv: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.modern: So I went down to the potter's house, and I saw Him working at the wheel.

verses.kjv: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.modern: But the pot He was shaping from the clay was ruined in His hands. So the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to Him.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verses.modern: "Can I not do with You, Israel, as this potter does?" says the LORD. "Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are You in My hand, Israel.

verses.kjv: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
verses.modern: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed,

verses.kjv: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.modern: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not bring on it the disaster I had planned.

verses.kjv: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.modern: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

verses.kjv: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.modern: and if it does evil in My sight and does not obey Me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

verses.kjv: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am framing evil against you, and devising a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.modern: Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem, 'This is what the LORD says: Look — I am preparing a disaster for You and devising a plan against You. Turn from Your evil ways, each of You, and reform Your ways and Your actions.'

verses.kjv: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.modern: But they will reply, 'It is no use. We will continue with our own plans. Each of us will follow the stubbornness of our evil heart.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Ask the nations: Has anyone heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.

verses.kjv: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.modern: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever stop flowing?

verses.kjv: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
verses.modern: Yet My people have forgotten Me. They burn incense to worthless idols. They have stumbled off the ancient paths and walk on byways — roads not built up.

verses.kjv: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.modern: Their land will be laid waste — an object of lasting scorn. All who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.

verses.kjv: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.modern: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies. I will show them My back and not My face in the day of their disaster."

verses.kjv: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.modern: They said, "Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah. Surely the teaching of the law by the priest will not cease, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. Come, let us attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says."

verses.kjv: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.modern: Listen to me, LORD. Hear what my accusers are saying.

verses.kjv: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.modern: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before You and spoke on their behalf to turn Your wrath away from them.

verses.kjv: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
verses.modern: So give their children over to famine. Hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck down by the sword in battle.

verses.kjv: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.modern: Let a cry be heard from their houses when You suddenly bring raiders against them — for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

verses.kjv: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.modern: But You, LORD, know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their iniquity or blot out their sins from Your sight. Let them be overthrown before You. Deal with them in the time of Your anger.

chapters.summary: The LORD sent Jeremiah to the potter's house, where the potter reworked a marred vessel into another vessel as it pleased him. As the clay is in the potter's hand, so is Israel in the LORD's hand -- He can pluck up or build a nation as He chooses. The people plotted against Jeremiah, and he prayed for the LORD to deal with them in the time of His anger.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD said: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and some of the leading priests.

verses.kjv: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
verses.modern: Go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. Proclaim there the words I tell You.

verses.kjv: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.modern: Say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, You kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it ring.

verses.kjv: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.modern: For they have forsaken Me and made this a foreign place. They have burned incense here to other gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew. They have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

verses.kjv: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.modern: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal — something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter My mind.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.modern: So the days are coming,' says the LORD, 'when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

verses.kjv: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.modern: In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies — at the hands of those who want to kill them. I will give their bodies as food for the birds of the air and the wild animals.

verses.kjv: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.modern: I will devastate this city and make it an object of scorn. Everyone who passes by will be appalled and will scoff at all its wounds.

verses.kjv: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
