verses.modern: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters. They will eat each other's flesh during the siege — the distress their enemies will inflict on them as they try to destroy them.'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.modern: Then break the jar in front of the men who went with You

verses.kjv: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
verses.modern: and say to them, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter's jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no room to bury anyone.'

verses.kjv: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
verses.modern: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here," says the LORD. "I will make this city like Topheth.

verses.kjv: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.modern: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place of Topheth — all the houses where they burned incense on the rooftops to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods."

verses.kjv: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD's house; and said to all the people,
verses.modern: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent Him to prophesy, and He stood in the court of the LORD's house and said to all the people:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'I am going to bring on this city and on all the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to My words.'"

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to buy a potter's earthen bottle and go to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom. He prophesied that the valley would be called the Valley of Slaughter because of the innocent blood shed there. Jeremiah broke the bottle before the elders as a sign that the LORD would break Jerusalem and her people beyond repair.

verses.kjv: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.modern: Now Pashhur son of Immer, the priest who was chief officer in the temple of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

verses.kjv: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: So Pashhur had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin in the LORD's temple.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
verses.modern: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The LORD's name for You is not Pashhur but 'Terror on Every Side.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says: 'I will make You a terror to Yourself and to all Your friends. You will watch them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.modern: I will hand over to their enemies all the wealth of this city — all its produce and all its valuables, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it all to Babylon as plunder.

verses.kjv: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
verses.modern: And You, Pashhur, and all who live in Your house will go into exile to Babylon. There You will die and be buried — you and all Your friends to whom You have prophesied lies.'"

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
verses.modern: LORD, You deceived me and I was deceived. You overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long — everyone mocks me.

verses.kjv: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.modern: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the LORD has brought me insult and reproach all day long.

verses.kjv: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verses.modern: But if I say, "I will not mention His word or speak anymore in His name," His word burns in my heart like a fire — a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in. Indeed, I cannot.

verses.kjv: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.modern: I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side! Report Him! Let's report Him!" All my closest friends are waiting for me to slip. They say, "Perhaps He will be deceived, and then we can overpower Him and take our revenge."

verses.kjv: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.modern: But the LORD is with me like a mighty warrior. So my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly ashamed — their dishonor will never be forgotten.

verses.kjv: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
verses.modern: LORD of hosts, You who test the righteous and see the heart and mind — let me see Your vengeance on them, for to You I have committed my cause.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For He has rescued the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.modern: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother gave birth to me not be blessed!

verses.kjv: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.modern: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, "A son is born to you!" — making him very glad.

verses.kjv: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.modern: May that man be like the towns the LORD overthrew without pity. May He hear wailing in the morning and battle cries at noon.

verses.kjv: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
verses.modern: For He did not kill me in the womb — he who let my mother be my grave, her womb enlarged forever.

verses.kjv: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.modern: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?

chapters.summary: Pashur the priest, chief governor of the temple, struck Jeremiah and put him in stocks. When released, Jeremiah renamed Pashur 'Magormissabib' -- terror on every side -- and prophesied that all Judah would be given to the king of Babylon. Jeremiah cursed the day he was born, crying that the word of the LORD had made him a reproach, yet it burned in his heart like fire and he could not hold it in.

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:

verses.kjv: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.modern: "Please ask the LORD for us, because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will perform miracles for us as He did in the past and make Him withdraw from us."

verses.kjv: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.modern: Jeremiah answered them, "Tell Zedekiah:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.modern: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against You the weapons of war that are in Your hands — the ones You are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging You. I will bring those weapons into the center of this city.

verses.kjv: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.modern: I Myself will fight against You with outstretched hand and powerful arm — in anger, in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.kjv: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.modern: I will strike the inhabitants of this city — both people and animals. They will die of a terrible plague.

verses.kjv: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.modern: After that,' says the LORD, 'I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the people of this city who survive the plague, the sword, and the famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will strike them down with the sword — he will show them no mercy, pity, or compassion.'

verses.kjv: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.modern: Tell this people, 'This is what the LORD says: See, I am setting before You the way of life and the way of death.

verses.kjv: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.modern: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword, famine, or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging You will live — their life will be spared.

verses.kjv: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.modern: I have determined to bring disaster on this city and not good,' says the LORD. 'It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.'

verses.kjv: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.modern: "To the royal house of Judah, say: 'Hear the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.modern: House of David, this is what the LORD says: Administer justice every morning. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor whoever has been robbed, or My anger will break out and burn like fire because of the evil You have done — burn with no one able to quench it.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.modern: I am against You, Jerusalem, who live above this valley on the rocky plateau,' says the LORD. 'You say, "Who can attack us? Who can enter our stronghold?"

verses.kjv: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.modern: I will punish You as Your deeds deserve,' says the LORD. 'I will kindle a fire in Your forests that will consume everything around You.'"

chapters.summary: King Zedekiah sent to Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD when Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem. The LORD answered that He Himself would fight against Judah with an outstretched hand and would deliver Zedekiah into Nebuchadnezzar's hand. He set before the people the way of life and the way of death -- whoever surrendered to the Chaldeans would live.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there.

verses.kjv: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
verses.modern: Say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, king of Judah, You who sit on David's throne — you, your officials, and your people who come through these gates.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor those who have been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Do not shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.kjv: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.modern: If you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses — they and their officials and their people.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.modern: But if You do not obey these commands, I swear by Myself,' says the LORD, 'that this palace will become a ruin.'"

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says about the palace of the king of Judah: "Though you are like Gilead to Me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make You a desert, like towns not inhabited.

verses.kjv: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.modern: I will send destroyers against You, each armed with weapons. They will cut down Your finest cedars and throw them into the fire.

verses.kjv: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
verses.modern: People from many nations will pass by this city and ask one another, 'Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?'

verses.kjv: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.modern: And the answer will be: 'Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.'"

verses.kjv: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.modern: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn for Him. Rather weep bitterly for the one who is exiled, because he will never return or see His native land again.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father Josiah as king of Judah but has gone from this place: "He will never return here.

verses.kjv: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.modern: He will die in the place where they have taken Him captive. He will not see this land again."

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
verses.modern: "Woe to Him who builds His palace by unrighteous means and His upper rooms by injustice — who makes His neighbors work for nothing, paying them no wages.

verses.kjv: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.modern: He says, 'I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.' So He makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.

verses.kjv: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
verses.modern: Does it make You a king to have more and more cedar? Did not Your father eat and drink and do justice and what is right? Then things went well for Him.

verses.kjv: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: He defended the cause of the poor and needy. Then things went well. Is that not what it means to know Me?' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.modern: But Your eyes and Your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on oppression and extortion."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They will not mourn for him, saying, 'Alas, my brother!' or 'Alas, my sister!' They will not mourn for Him, saying, 'Alas, my master! Alas, His splendor!'

verses.kjv: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: He will have the burial of a donkey — dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.modern: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out. Raise Your voice in Bashan. Cry out from Abarim, for all Your allies are crushed.

verses.kjv: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.modern: I warned You when You felt secure, but You said, 'I will not listen!' This has been Your pattern since Your youth — you have not obeyed Me.

verses.kjv: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.modern: The wind will drive away all Your shepherds, and Your allies will go into exile. Then You will be ashamed and disgraced because of all Your wickedness.

verses.kjv: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.modern: You who live in Lebanon, who are nestled in cedar buildings, how You will groan when pain comes upon You — pain like that of a woman in labor!

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.modern: "As surely as I live," says the LORD, "even if You, Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, I would still pull You off.

verses.kjv: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.modern: I will hand you over to those who seek your life, those you fear — Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.modern: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born. There you will die.

verses.kjv: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.modern: You will never come back to the land you long to return to."

verses.kjv: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.modern: Is this man Coniah a despised, broken pot — an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out and thrown into a land they do not know?

verses.kjv: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: Land! Land! Land! Hear the word of the LORD!

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Record this man as childless — a man who will not prosper in his lifetime. None of His offspring will succeed in sitting on the throne of David or ruling in Judah."

chapters.summary: The LORD sent Jeremiah to the king's house to demand justice and righteousness, warning that if they disobeyed, the palace would become a desolation. He pronounced judgment on Shallum, Jehoiakim, and Coniah, declaring that Coniah would be cast out and none of his descendants would prosper sitting on the throne of David.

verses.kjv: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend My people: "Because You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not taken care of them, I will punish You for the evil You have done," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.modern: "I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the countries where I have driven them. I will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and multiply.

verses.kjv: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified. Not one of them will be missing," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch — a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.

verses.kjv: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.modern: In His days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which He will be called: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.modern: "So the days are coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

verses.kjv: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.modern: but they will say, 'As the LORD lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where He had driven them.' Then they will live in their own land."

verses.kjv: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.modern: My heart is broken within me because of the prophets. All my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like someone overcome by wine, because of the LORD and because of His holy words.

verses.kjv: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.modern: The land is full of adulterers. Because of them the land mourns. The pleasant pastures in the desert are dried up. The prophets run in an evil course and use their power unjustly.

verses.kjv: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "Both prophet and priest are godless. Even in My temple I find their wickedness," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "Therefore their path will become slippery. They will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year I punish them," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.modern: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw something repulsive: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.

verses.kjv: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.modern: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that not one of them turns from their wickedness. They are all like Sodom to Me. The people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to You. They fill You with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.

verses.kjv: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.modern: They keep saying to those who despise Me, 'The LORD says: You will have peace.' And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, 'No harm will come to You.'

verses.kjv: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.modern: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see or to hear His word? Who has listened and heard His word?

verses.kjv: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.modern: A storm of the LORD has gone out in fury — a driving whirlwind. It will swirl down on the heads of the wicked.

verses.kjv: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.modern: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He fully accomplishes the purposes of His heart. In days to come You will understand it clearly.

verses.kjv: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.modern: I did not send these prophets, yet they ran with their message. I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.kjv: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.modern: But if they had stood in My council, they would have proclaimed My words to My people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.

verses.kjv: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
verses.modern: "Am I only a God nearby," says the LORD, "and not a God far away?

verses.kjv: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Can anyone hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?" says the LORD. "Do I not fill heaven and earth?" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.modern: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in My name. They say, 'I had a dream! I had a dream!'

verses.kjv: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.modern: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?

verses.kjv: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.modern: They think the dreams they tell one another will make My people forget My name, just as their ancestors forgot My name through Baal worship.

verses.kjv: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully: what is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Let the prophet who has a dream recount the dream, but let the one who has My word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.modern: "Is not My word like fire," says the LORD, "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.modern: Therefore I am against the prophets," says the LORD, "who steal from one another words supposedly from Me.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.modern: I am against the prophets," says the LORD, "who wag their own tongues and yet declare, 'The LORD declares.'

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I am against those who prophesy false dreams," says the LORD. "They tell them and lead My people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask You, 'What is the burden of the LORD?' say to them, 'What burden? I will forsake You,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.modern: But if a prophet or priest or anyone else claims, 'This is a burden from the LORD,' I will punish that person and their household.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.modern: This is what each of You keeps saying to Your friends and fellow Israelites: 'What is the LORD's answer?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

verses.kjv: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
verses.modern: But You must no longer mention 'a burden from the LORD,' because every person's own word becomes their burden, and so You distort the words of the living God — the LORD of hosts, our God.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.modern: This is what You keep saying to a prophet: 'What is the LORD's answer to You?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

verses.kjv: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
verses.modern: Although You claim, 'This is a burden from the LORD,' this is what the LORD says: You used the words 'a burden from the LORD,' even though I told You that You must not claim this.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.modern: Therefore I will surely forget You and cast You out of My presence along with the city I gave to You and Your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.modern: I will bring everlasting disgrace on You and everlasting shame that will not be forgotten."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced woe on the shepherds who scattered His flock, and promised to raise up a righteous Branch from David who would reign as king and execute judgment and justice -- whose name would be called THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS. He rebuked the prophets of Jerusalem who prophesied lies in His name, committed adultery, and strengthened the hands of evildoers.

verses.kjv: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.modern: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried into exile from Jerusalem Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, together with the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and artisans of Jerusalem, and had taken them to Babylon — the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.modern: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen first. The other basket had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.modern: Then the LORD asked me, "What do You see, Jeremiah?" "Figs," I answered. "The good ones are very good, but the bad ones are so bad they cannot be eaten."

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.modern: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down. I will plant them and not uproot them.

verses.kjv: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.modern: I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.

verses.kjv: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.modern: "'But like the bad figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,' says the LORD, 'so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.modern: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth — a disgrace and a byword, an object of ridicule and cursing, wherever I banish them.

verses.kjv: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.modern: I will send the sword, famine, and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.'"

chapters.summary: After Nebuchadnezzar carried Jeconiah and the craftsmen of Judah to Babylon, the LORD showed Jeremiah two baskets of figs set before the temple. The good figs represented the exiles in Babylon, whom the LORD would watch over and bring back. The bad figs represented Zedekiah and those who remained in Jerusalem, whom the LORD would give up to be a curse among all nations.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.modern: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.modern: Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people of Judah and all those living in Jerusalem:

verses.kjv: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.modern: "For twenty-three years — from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day — the word of the LORD has come to me and I have spoken to You again and again, but You have not listened.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.modern: And though the LORD has sent all His servants the prophets to you again and again, you have not listened or paid any attention.

verses.kjv: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.modern: They said, 'Turn now, each of You, from Your evil ways and Your evil practices, and You can stay in the land the LORD gave to You and Your ancestors for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.modern: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them. Do not arouse My anger with what Your hands have made. Then I will not harm You.'

verses.kjv: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.modern: But You did not listen to Me," says the LORD, "and You have aroused My anger with what Your hands have made, bringing harm to yourselves.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: 'Because You have not listened to My words,

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.modern: I will summon all the peoples of the north and My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,' says the LORD, 'and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn — a ruin forever.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.modern: I will remove from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and groom, the sound of millstones, and the light of every lamp.

verses.kjv: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.modern: This whole land will become a ruin and a wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.modern: But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation — the land of the Babylonians — for their iniquity,' says the LORD, 'and will make it desolate forever.

verses.kjv: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.modern: I will bring on that land all the words I have spoken against it — everything written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.

verses.kjv: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.modern: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings. I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands.'"

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from My hand this cup filled with the wine of My wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

verses.kjv: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.modern: When they drink it, they will stagger and go out of their minds because of the sword I will send among them."

verses.kjv: Then took I the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.modern: So I took the cup from the LORD's hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:

verses.kjv: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.modern: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah and its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn and cursing — as they are today;

verses.kjv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.modern: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,

verses.kjv: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.modern: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines — those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod;

verses.kjv: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.modern: Edom, Moab, and Ammon;

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.modern: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;

verses.kjv: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.modern: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who are in distant places;

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.modern: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the desert;

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.modern: all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media;

verses.kjv: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.modern: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after another — all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Babylon will drink it too.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.modern: "Then tell them, 'This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more, because of the sword I will send among You.'

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.modern: But if they refuse to take the cup from Your hand and drink, tell them, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: You must drink it!

verses.kjv: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be altogether unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears My name, and will You indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword on all who live on the earth,' says the LORD of hosts."

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.modern: "Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: 'The LORD will roar from on high. He will thunder from His holy dwelling and roar mightily against His land. He will shout like those who tread grapes — He will shout against all who live on the earth.

verses.kjv: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The uproar will resound to the ends of the earth, for the LORD will bring charges against the nations. He will judge all humanity. The wicked he will give over to the sword,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: 'Look — disaster is spreading from nation to nation. A mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.'

verses.kjv: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.modern: At that time those slain by the LORD will be everywhere — from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered or buried. They will be like dung lying on the ground.

verses.kjv: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.modern: Wail, You shepherds, and cry out! Roll in the dust, You leaders of the flock! For Your time to be slaughtered has come. You will fall and shatter like fine pottery.

verses.kjv: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.modern: The shepherds will find no place to flee. The leaders of the flock will not escape.

verses.kjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.modern: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock — for the LORD is destroying their pasture.

verses.kjv: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.modern: The peaceful meadows will be laid waste because of the LORD's fierce anger.

verses.kjv: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.modern: Like a lion He has left His den, for their land has become desolate because of the sword of the oppressor and because of the LORD's fierce anger.

chapters.summary: Jeremiah warned the people for twenty-three years, but they did not listen. The LORD declared that the whole land would be a desolation, and the nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years. After seventy years the LORD would punish Babylon. Jeremiah took the cup of the wine of God's fury and made all the nations drink it, for the LORD was calling for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.kjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the LORD's house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the LORD. Tell them everything I command You. Do not omit a word.

verses.kjv: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.modern: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil way. Then I will relent and not bring on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.modern: Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: If You do not listen to Me and follow My law, which I have set before You,

verses.kjv: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.modern: and if You do not listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I have sent to You again and again — though You have not listened —

verses.kjv: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.modern: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.'"

verses.kjv: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: The priests, the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.modern: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded Him to say, the priests and prophets and all the people seized him and said, "You must die!

verses.kjv: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Why do You prophesy in the LORD's name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?" And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house.
verses.modern: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the royal palace to the house of the LORD and took their seats at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD's house.

verses.kjv: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.modern: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, "This man should be sentenced to death! He has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!"

verses.kjv: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.modern: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: "The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the words You have heard.

verses.kjv: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.modern: Now reform Your ways and Your actions and obey the LORD Your God. Then the LORD will relent and not bring the disaster He has pronounced against You.

verses.kjv: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.modern: As for me, I am in Your hands. Do with me whatever You think is good and right.

verses.kjv: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.modern: But be assured of this: If You put me to death, You will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it. For in truth the LORD has sent me to You to speak all these words in Your hearing."

verses.kjv: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
verses.modern: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God."

verses.kjv: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.modern: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people:

verses.kjv: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.modern: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.'

verses.kjv: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.modern: Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the LORD and seek His favor? And did not the LORD relent, so that He did not bring on them the disaster He had pronounced? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!"

verses.kjv: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
verses.modern: Now Urijah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim was another man who prophesied in the name of the LORD. He prophesied the same things against this city and this land as Jeremiah did.

verses.kjv: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.modern: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king sought to put him to death. But Urijah heard of it and was afraid. He fled to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.modern: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Achbor to Egypt, along with some other men.

verses.kjv: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.modern: They brought Urijah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial ground of the common people.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.modern: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah and kept him from being handed over to the people to be put to death.

chapters.summary: The LORD sent Jeremiah to the temple court to speak all the words He commanded, withholding nothing. When the priests and prophets heard, they seized him and said he deserved to die. The princes and people defended Jeremiah, citing the precedent of Micah the prophet whom Hezekiah did not put to death, but Urijah the prophet was killed by King Jehoiakim.

verses.kjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD said to me: Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on Your neck.

verses.kjv: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.modern: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

verses.kjv: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.modern: Give them a message for their masters and say, 'This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Tell this to Your masters:

verses.kjv: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.modern: With My great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and animals, and I give it to anyone I please.

verses.kjv: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.modern: Now I will give all your countries to My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I will make even the wild animals subject to him.

verses.kjv: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.modern: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes. Then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.modern: If, however, any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or bow its neck under His yoke, I will punish that nation with sword, famine, and plague,' says the LORD, 'until I destroy it by His hand.

verses.kjv: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.modern: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your fortune-tellers, or your sorcerers who tell you, "You will not serve the king of Babylon."

verses.kjv: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.modern: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands. I would banish you and you would perish.

verses.kjv: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.modern: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to cultivate it and to live there,' says the LORD.'"

verses.kjv: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.modern: I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, "Bow your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon. Serve him and his people, and you will live.

verses.kjv: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.modern: Why will You and Your people die by the sword, famine, and plague with which the LORD has threatened every nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.kjv: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.modern: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' for they are prophesying lies to you.

verses.kjv: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.modern: I have not sent them," says the LORD. "They are prophesying lies in My name. Therefore I will banish You and You will perish — both You and the prophets who prophesy to You."

verses.kjv: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.modern: Then I said to the priests and all these people, "This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, 'Very soon now the articles from the LORD's house will be brought back from Babylon.' They are prophesying lies to You.

verses.kjv: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.modern: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?

verses.kjv: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.modern: If they are prophets and have the word of the LORD, let them plead with the LORD of hosts that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD of hosts says about the pillars, the bronze Sea, the movable stands, and the other articles that remain in this city,

verses.kjv: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.modern: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he carried away Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem —

verses.kjv: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
verses.modern: yes, this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:

verses.kjv: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.modern: 'They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,' says the LORD. 'Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.'"

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to make yokes and send them to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon, declaring that He had given all these lands to Nebuchadnezzar. Any nation that refused to serve Babylon would be punished with sword, famine, and pestilence. The prophets who said the vessels of the LORD's house would soon return from Babylon were lying.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.modern: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people:

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.modern: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the LORD's house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.modern: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,' says the LORD, 'for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.'"

verses.kjv: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
verses.modern: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.modern: He said, "Amen! May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words You have prophesied by bringing the articles of the LORD's house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.modern: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in Your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:

verses.kjv: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.modern: From early times the prophets who came before You and me have prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.

verses.kjv: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
verses.modern: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the LORD only if His prediction comes true."

verses.kjv: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
verses.modern: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it.

verses.kjv: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.modern: Hananiah said before all the people, "This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.'" At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: Shortly after the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.modern: "Go and tell Hananiah, 'This is what the LORD says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place You will get a yoke of iron.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve Him. I will even give Him control over the wild animals.'"

verses.kjv: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.modern: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent You, yet You have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'I am about to remove You from the face of the earth. This very year You are going to die, because You have preached rebellion against the LORD.'"

verses.kjv: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.modern: In the seventh month of that same year, the prophet Hananiah died.

chapters.summary: Hananiah the prophet broke the yoke from Jeremiah's neck and prophesied that within two years the LORD would break the yoke of Babylon and bring back the vessels and the exiles. Jeremiah said amen, may the LORD do so, but the prophet who prophesies peace is only proven when his word comes to pass. The LORD sent Jeremiah back with yokes of iron and declared that Hananiah would die that year -- and he did.

verses.kjv: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.modern: This is the text of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets, and all the other people Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
