verses.kjv: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.modern: This was after King Jehoiachin and the queen mother, the court officials and the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen and artisans had left Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.modern: He sent the letter by Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.kjv: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.modern: 'Build houses and live in them. Plant gardens and eat what they produce.

verses.kjv: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.modern: Marry and have sons and daughters. Find wives for Your sons and give Your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there — do not decrease.

verses.kjv: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.modern: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried You into exile. Pray to the LORD for it, because if it prospers, You too will prosper.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.modern: Yes, this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'Do not let the prophets and diviners among You deceive You. Do not listen to the dreams You encourage them to have.

verses.kjv: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: They are prophesying lies to You in My name. I have not sent them,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: 'When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to You and fulfill My good promise to bring You back to this place.

verses.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.modern: For I know the thoughts that I think toward You, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give You an expected end.

verses.kjv: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.modern: Then You will call on Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.modern: You will seek Me and find Me when You seek Me with all Your heart.

verses.kjv: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.modern: I will be found by You,' says the LORD, 'and will bring You back from captivity. I will gather You from all the nations and places where I have banished you,' says the LORD, 'and will bring You back to the place from which I carried You into exile.'

verses.kjv: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.modern: You may say, "The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon" —

verses.kjv: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.modern: but this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David's throne and all the people who remain in this city, your fellow citizens who did not go into exile with You —

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.modern: yes, this is what the LORD of hosts says: "I will send sword, famine, and plague against them and I will make them like bad figs that are so rotten they cannot be eaten.

verses.kjv: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.modern: I will pursue them with sword, famine, and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth — a curse and an object of horror, scorn, and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.

verses.kjv: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: For they have not listened to My words," says the LORD, "words that I sent to them again and again through My servants the prophets. And You exiles have not listened either," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.modern: Therefore, all You exiles whom I sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to You in My name: "I will hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before Your very eyes.

verses.kjv: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.modern: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: 'May the LORD treat You like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.'

verses.kjv: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: For they have done outrageous things in Israel — they have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and have spoken in My name words I did not command. I know it and I am a witness to it," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.modern: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite:

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in Your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the other priests. You told Zephaniah:

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.modern: 'The LORD has appointed You priest in place of Jehoiada. You are to be in charge of the house of the LORD over every madman who acts like a prophet. You should put Him in the stocks and the iron collar.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.modern: So why have You not rebuked Jeremiah from Anathoth, who acts as your prophet?'

verses.kjv: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.modern: He has even sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat what they produce."

verses.kjv: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.modern: Zephaniah the priest, however, read the letter to Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.modern: "Send this message to all the exiles: 'This is what the LORD says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to You, even though I did not send Him, and has persuaded You to trust in lies —

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for My people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.modern: therefore this is what the LORD says: I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and His descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good things I will do for My people,' says the LORD, 'because He has preached rebellion against the LORD.'"

chapters.summary: Jeremiah sent a letter to the exiles in Babylon, telling them to build houses, plant gardens, marry, and seek the peace of the city where the LORD had sent them. He promised that after seventy years the LORD would visit them and bring them back, declaring, 'I know the thoughts I think toward you, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.'

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Write in a book all the words I have spoken to You.

verses.kjv: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.modern: The days are coming,' says the LORD, 'when I will restore the fortunes of My people Israel and Judah,' says the LORD. 'I will bring them back to the land I gave their ancestors, and they will take possession of it.'"

verses.kjv: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.modern: These are the words the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah:

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: 'I hear a cry of fear — there is terror, not peace.

verses.kjv: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.modern: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, and every face turned deathly pale?

verses.kjv: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.modern: How awful that day will be! No other will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.

verses.kjv: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.modern: In that day,' says the LORD of hosts, 'I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds. Foreigners will no longer enslave them.

verses.kjv: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.modern: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

verses.kjv: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.modern: So do not be afraid, My servant Jacob,' says the LORD. 'Do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save You from a distant place — your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make them afraid.

verses.kjv: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.modern: I am with You and will save You,' says the LORD. 'Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy You. I will discipline You but only with justice. I will not let You go entirely unpunished.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: 'Your wound is incurable, Your injury beyond healing.

verses.kjv: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.modern: There is no one to plead your cause — no remedy for your sore, no healing for You.

verses.kjv: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.modern: All Your allies have forgotten You. They care nothing for You. I have struck You as an enemy would — with the punishment of the cruel — because Your iniquity is so great and Your sins so many.

verses.kjv: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.modern: Why do You cry out over Your wound? Your pain has no cure! Because of Your great iniquity and Your many sins I have done these things to You.

verses.kjv: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.modern: But all who devour You will be devoured. All Your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder You will be plundered. All who make spoil of You I will despoil.

verses.kjv: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.modern: But I will restore You to health and heal Your wounds,' says the LORD, 'because You are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: 'I will restore the fortunes of Jacob's tents and have compassion on his homes. The city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.

verses.kjv: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.modern: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased. I will bring them honor, and they will not be looked down on.

verses.kjv: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.modern: Their children will be as they were before, and their community will be established before Me. I will punish all who oppress them.

verses.kjv: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Their leader will be one of their own. Their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring Him near and He will come close to Me, for who is He who will devote himself to be close to Me?' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.modern: 'So You will be My people, and I will be Your God.'"

verses.kjv: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.modern: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath — a driving whirlwind. It will swirl down on the heads of the wicked.

verses.kjv: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.modern: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until He fully accomplishes the purposes of His heart. In days to come You will understand this.

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to write all His words in a book, for the days were coming when He would bring His people back from captivity. Though Jacob's trouble would be great, the LORD would save him out of it and break his yoke. The LORD would restore health to Zion and heal her wounds, and David's city would be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.modern: "At that time," says the LORD, "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "The people who survived the sword found grace in the desert. Israel is going to find rest."

verses.kjv: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.modern: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: "I have loved You with an everlasting love. I have drawn You with loving-kindness.

verses.kjv: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.modern: I will build You up again, and You will be rebuilt, Virgin Israel. Again You will take up Your tambourines and go out to dance with the joyful.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.modern: Again You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria. The farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.

verses.kjv: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
verses.modern: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, 'Come, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God.'"

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Sing with joy for Jacob. Shout for the greatest of the nations. Make your praises heard and say, 'LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel.'

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.modern: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor — a great crowd will return.

verses.kjv: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.modern: They will come with weeping. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel's father and Ephraim is My firstborn son.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.modern: Hear the word of the LORD, You nations. Proclaim it in distant coastlands: 'He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.'

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.modern: For the LORD has redeemed Jacob and has rescued him from the hand of those stronger than He.

verses.kjv: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.modern: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion. They will rejoice in the goodness of the LORD — the grain, the new wine, the olive oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden and will sorrow no more.

verses.kjv: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.modern: Then young women will dance and be glad — young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness. I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.

verses.kjv: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and My people will be filled with My goodness," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "A voice is heard in Ramah — mourning and great weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Restrain Your voice from weeping and Your eyes from tears, for Your work will be rewarded," says the LORD. "They will return from the land of the enemy.

verses.kjv: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.modern: So there is hope for Your descendants," says the LORD. "Your children will return to their own land.

verses.kjv: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.
verses.modern: "I have surely heard Ephraim's moaning: 'You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me and I will return, because You are the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.modern: After I strayed, I repented. After I came to understand, I beat my chest. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.'

verses.kjv: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Is not Ephraim My dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against Him, I still remember Him. Therefore My heart yearns for Him. I will surely have mercy on Him," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.modern: "Set up road signs. Put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that You take. Return, Virgin Israel. Return to Your towns.

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.modern: How long will You wander, unfaithful daughter? The LORD will create a new thing on earth — a woman will surround a man."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: 'The LORD bless You, You righteous dwelling, You sacred mountain.'

verses.kjv: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.modern: People will live together in Judah and all its towns — farmers and those who move about with their flocks.

verses.kjv: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.modern: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint."

verses.kjv: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.modern: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will plant the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the offspring of people and of animals.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, to overthrow and destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.modern: "In those days people will no longer say, 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge.'

verses.kjv: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.modern: Instead, everyone will die for their own iniquity. Whoever eats sour grapes — their own teeth will be set on edge.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

verses.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
verses.modern: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt — a covenant they broke, though I was a husband to them," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.modern: "This is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after that time," says the LORD. "I will put My law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts. I will be their God and they will be My people.

verses.kjv: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.modern: No longer will they teach their neighbors, or say to one another, 'Know the LORD,' because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest," says the LORD. "For I will forgive their iniquity and will remember their sin no more."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says, He who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar — the LORD of hosts is His name:

verses.kjv: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.modern: "Only if these decrees vanish from My sight," says the LORD, "will Israel ever cease being a nation before Me."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when this city will be rebuilt for Me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

verses.kjv: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.modern: The measuring line will stretch from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to Goah.

verses.kjv: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.modern: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown, and all the terraces out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the corner of the Horse Gate, will be holy to the LORD. The city will never again be uprooted or demolished."

chapters.summary: The LORD declared His everlasting love for Israel and promised to build her again. Rachel weeps for her children, but the LORD tells her to stop weeping, for they shall come back from the enemy's land. The LORD will make a new covenant with Israel -- not like the one He made when He brought them out of Egypt -- writing His law on their hearts, and all shall know Him from the least to the greatest.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
verses.modern: The army of the king of Babylon was then besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace of Judah.

verses.kjv: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.modern: Now Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him there, saying, "Why do You prophesy as You do? You say, 'This is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.modern: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape the Babylonians but will certainly be given into the hands of the king of Babylon. He will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.

verses.kjv: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.modern: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with Him,' says the LORD. 'If You fight against the Babylonians, You will not succeed.'"

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Jeremiah said, "The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
verses.modern: 'Hanameel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, "Buy my field at Anathoth, because as next of kin it is Your right and duty to buy it."'"

verses.kjv: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: Then, just as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanameel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, "Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is Your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for Yourself." I knew that this was the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.modern: So I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanameel and weighed out for Him seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.modern: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.

verses.kjv: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.modern: I took both the sealed copy of the deed of purchase — the one containing the terms and conditions — and the unsealed copy.

verses.kjv: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.modern: I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanameel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Judeans sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

verses.kjv: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.modern: In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take both this sealed deed of purchase and this unsealed deed and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land."

verses.kjv: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:

verses.kjv: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.modern: "Ah, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for You.

verses.kjv: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
verses.modern: You show mercy to thousands and bring the punishment of the fathers' sins into the laps of their children after them. You are the great and mighty God, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.modern: Your purposes are great and Your deeds are mighty. Your eyes are open to all the ways of all people. You reward everyone according to their conduct and as their deeds deserve.

verses.kjv: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.modern: You performed signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, in Israel and among all people, and have gained the renown that is still Yours.

verses.kjv: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.modern: You brought Your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.

verses.kjv: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.modern: You gave them this land You had sworn to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.modern: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey You or follow Your law. They did not do what You commanded them to do. So You brought all this disaster on them.

verses.kjv: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
verses.modern: See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of sword, famine, and plague, the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians who are attacking it. What You said has happened, as You now see.

verses.kjv: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.modern: And though the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians, You have said to me, Lord GOD: 'Buy the field with silver and have the transaction witnessed.'"

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.modern: "I am the LORD, the God of all people. Is anything too hard for Me?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.modern: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.

verses.kjv: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.modern: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire. They will burn it down — along with the houses where the people aroused My anger by burning incense on their rooftops to Baal and pouring out drink offerings to other gods.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth. The people of Israel have done nothing but arouse My anger with what their hands have made," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.modern: From the day it was built until now, this city has aroused My anger and wrath, so that I must remove it from My sight.

verses.kjv: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The people of Israel and Judah have provoked Me by all the evil they and their kings, officials, priests, and prophets — the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem — have done.

verses.kjv: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.modern: They turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.

verses.kjv: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.modern: They set up their vile images in the house that bears My name and defiled it.

verses.kjv: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.modern: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molech, though I never commanded — nor did it enter My mind — that they should do such a detestable thing to lead Judah into sin.

verses.kjv: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.modern: "You are saying about this city, 'By sword, famine, and plague it will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon.' But this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:

verses.kjv: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.modern: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in My furious anger and great wrath. I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.

verses.kjv: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
verses.modern: They will be My people and I will be their God.

verses.kjv: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.modern: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear Me and that all will then go well for them and for their children after them.

verses.kjv: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.modern: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear Me, so that they will never turn away from Me.

verses.kjv: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.modern: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all My heart and soul.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.

verses.kjv: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.modern: Once more fields will be bought in this land about which You say, 'It is a desolate wasteland, without people or animals — it has been given into the hands of the Babylonians.'

verses.kjv: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Men shall buy fields for money and subscribe evidences, seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, in the places about Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south. For I will cause their captivity to return," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: While Jerusalem was under siege, the LORD told Jeremiah to buy a field in Anathoth from his cousin Hanameel as a sign that houses and fields would be bought again in the land. Jeremiah obeyed and prayed, marveling at the LORD's power. The LORD confirmed that though He was giving the city to the Chaldeans because of Judah's sin, He would gather His people and make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.modern: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to Him a second time:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says, He who made the earth, the LORD Who formed it and established it — the LORD is His name:

verses.kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.modern: Call to Me and I will answer You and show You great and mighty things You do not know.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword —

verses.kjv: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.modern: the houses where people fought the Babylonians but were filled with the bodies of those I struck down in My anger and wrath, those whose wickedness made Me hide My face from this city:

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.modern: 'Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it. I will heal My people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.

verses.kjv: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.modern: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel and will rebuild them as they were before.

verses.kjv: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.modern: I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and I will forgive all their iniquities by which they sinned against Me and rebelled against Me.

verses.kjv: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.modern: Then this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it. They will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: 'You say about this place, "It is a desolate wasteland, without people or animals." Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted — inhabited by neither people nor animals — there will be heard once more

verses.kjv: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and groom, and the voices of those who bring thank offerings to the house of the LORD, saying, "Give thanks to the LORD of hosts, for the LORD is good. His mercy endures forever." For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: 'In this place, desolate and without people or animals — in all its towns — there will again be pastures where shepherds rest their flocks.

verses.kjv: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of Him that counts them,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.modern: "'The days are coming,' says the LORD, 'when I will fulfill the good promise I made to the people of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.modern: In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David's line. He will do what is just and right in the land.

verses.kjv: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
verses.modern: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says: 'David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of Israel,

verses.kjv: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.modern: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man to stand before Me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.'"

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: 'If You can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,

verses.kjv: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.modern: then My covenant with David My servant — and My covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before Me — can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.'

verses.kjv: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.modern: I will make the descendants of David My servant and the Levites who minister before Me as countless as the stars in the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.'"

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.modern: "Have You not noticed that these people are saying, 'The LORD has rejected the two kingdoms He chose'? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: 'If I have not made My covenant with day and night and established the laws of heaven and earth,

verses.kjv: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.modern: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David My servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.'"

chapters.summary: While Jeremiah was still imprisoned, the LORD told him to call and He would answer and show him great and mighty things. The LORD promised to heal Jerusalem, reveal abundance of peace and truth, and cause the Branch of Righteousness to spring forth from David. The covenant with David and with the Levitical priests would stand as firm as the LORD's covenant with day and night.

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.modern: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire He ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, 'This is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
verses.modern: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and given into his hands. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes. He will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.

verses.kjv: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.modern: Yet hear the word of the LORD, Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning You: You will not die by the sword.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: You will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of Your fathers, the former kings who preceded You, so they will make a fire in Your honor and lament for You, saying, "Alas, master!" I Myself make this promise,' says the LORD."

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
verses.modern: Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem

verses.kjv: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.modern: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out — Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.

verses.kjv: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
verses.modern: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim freedom for the slaves.

verses.kjv: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
verses.modern: Everyone was to free their Hebrew slaves, both male and female. No one was to hold a fellow Hebrew in bondage.

verses.kjv: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.modern: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.

verses.kjv: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.modern: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.

verses.kjv: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with Your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said:

verses.kjv: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.modern: 'Every seventh year each of You must free any fellow Hebrew who has sold Himself to You. After He has served You six years, You must let Him go free.' But Your ancestors did not listen to Me or pay attention to Me.

verses.kjv: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.modern: Recently You repented and did what is right in My sight: each of You proclaimed freedom to Your neighbors. You even made a covenant before Me in the house that bears My name.

verses.kjv: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom he had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.modern: But then You turned around and profaned My name. Each of You took back the male and female slaves You had set free. You forced them to become Your slaves again.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed Me — you have not proclaimed freedom to Your own people. So I now proclaim 'freedom' for You," says the LORD — "freedom to fall by the sword, plague, and famine. I will make You abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.kjv: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.modern: Those who have violated My covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before Me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two and then walked between its pieces.

verses.kjv: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.modern: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests, and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf —

verses.kjv: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.modern: I will give them into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them. Their bodies will be food for the birds of the air and the wild animals.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
verses.modern: I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them — to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: I am going to give the order," says the LORD, "and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

chapters.summary: Jeremiah told Zedekiah that the LORD would give Jerusalem to the king of Babylon and Zedekiah would be captured, but he would die in peace. The princes and people made a covenant to free their Hebrew slaves, then took them back into bondage. The LORD declared that because they profaned His name, He would give them to their enemies.

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

verses.kjv: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.modern: "Go to the community of the Rechabites and invite them to come to the house of the LORD into one of the side rooms. Then offer them wine."

verses.kjv: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.modern: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all His sons — the whole community of the Rechabites.

verses.kjv: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.modern: I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. This room was next to the room of the officials and directly above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.

verses.kjv: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
verses.modern: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the Rechabites and said, "Drink some wine."

verses.kjv: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
verses.modern: But they replied, "We do not drink wine, because our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab gave us this command: 'Neither You nor Your descendants must ever drink wine.

verses.kjv: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
verses.modern: Also You must never build houses, sow seed, or plant vineyards. You must never have any of these things. Instead You must always live in tents. Then You will live a long time in the land where You are strangers.'

verses.kjv: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.modern: We have obeyed everything Jonadab son of Rechab our ancestor commanded us. Neither we nor our wives nor our sons nor our daughters have ever drunk wine

verses.kjv: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.modern: or built houses or had vineyards, fields, or crops.

verses.kjv: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.modern: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, 'Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.' So we have been living in Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, 'Will You not learn a lesson and obey My words?' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
verses.modern: Jonadab son of Rechab ordered His descendants not to drink wine, and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their ancestor's command. But I have spoken to You again and again, yet You have not obeyed Me.

verses.kjv: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.modern: Again and again I sent all My servants the prophets to You. They said, "Each of You must turn from Your wicked ways and reform Your actions. Do not follow other gods to serve them. Then You will live in the land I have given to You and Your ancestors." But You have not paid attention or listened to Me.

verses.kjv: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
verses.modern: The descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab have carried out the command their ancestor gave them, but this people has not obeyed Me.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen. I called to them, but they did not answer.'"

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
verses.modern: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Rechabites, "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'You have obeyed the command of Your ancestor Jonadab and have followed all His instructions and have done everything He ordered.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a descendant to serve Me.'"

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into the temple and offer them wine. They refused, saying their ancestor Jonadab had commanded them never to drink wine, build houses, or plant vineyards. The LORD held up the Rechabites as an example of obedience that shamed Judah, for Judah would not listen to the LORD though He spoke to them persistently.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

verses.kjv: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
verses.modern: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah until now.

verses.kjv: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil that I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
verses.modern: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to bring on them, they will each turn from their wicked ways. Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin."

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
verses.modern: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the LORD had spoken to Him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
verses.modern: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, "I am restricted. I cannot go to the LORD's temple.

verses.kjv: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD's house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
verses.modern: So You go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the LORD that You wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.

verses.kjv: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
verses.modern: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD and will each turn from their wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the LORD are great."

verses.kjv: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD's house.
verses.modern: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do. At the LORD's temple He read the words of the LORD from the scroll.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the LORD was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house, in the ears of all the people.
verses.modern: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.

verses.kjv: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
verses.modern: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,

verses.kjv: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
