verses.modern: "Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol. Proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: 'Take Your positions and prepare yourselves, for the sword devours those around You.'

verses.kjv: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
verses.modern: Why will Your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the LORD will push them down.

verses.kjv: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
verses.modern: They will stumble repeatedly. They will fall over each other. They will say, 'Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.'

verses.kjv: There did they cry, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
verses.modern: There they will cry out, 'Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise. He has missed his opportunity.'

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
verses.modern: 'As surely as I live,' says the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, 'one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.

verses.kjv: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: Pack Your belongings for exile, You who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without anyone living there.'

verses.kjv: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
verses.modern: Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.

verses.kjv: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
verses.modern: The mercenaries in her ranks are like fattened calves. They too will turn and flee together. They will not stand their ground, for the day of disaster is coming on them — the time for them to be punished.

verses.kjv: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
verses.modern: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force. They will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.

verses.kjv: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
verses.modern: They will chop down her forest,' says the LORD, 'dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.

verses.kjv: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.modern: Daughter Egypt will be put to shame. She will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north."

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "I am about to punish Amon god of Thebes, Pharaoh, Egypt, and its gods and kings, and those who rely on Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will give them into the hands of those who seek their lives — Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Afterward, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.modern: "Do not be afraid, Jacob My servant. Do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save you from a distant place. I will bring your descendants back from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security. No one will make them afraid.

verses.kjv: Fear not thou, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid, Jacob My servant," says the LORD, "for I am with You. Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy You. I will discipline You but only in due measure. I will not let You go entirely unpunished."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced judgment against Egypt and its army, which Nebuchadnezzar defeated at Carchemish by the Euphrates. Egypt's mighty men would flee and fall, and the LORD declared that Nebuchadnezzar would come and strike the land of Egypt. But the LORD promised Jacob not to fear, for He would save them from afar and discipline them in measure, though He would make a full end of the nations.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.modern: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: Waters are rising in the north. They will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. People will cry out and all who live in the land will wail

verses.kjv: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.modern: at the sound of the hooves of galloping stallions, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Fathers will not turn back for their children. Their hands will hang limp

verses.kjv: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.modern: because the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to cut off all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.

verses.kjv: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.modern: Gaza will shave her head in mourning. Ashkelon will be silenced. You remnant on the plain, how long will You cut yourselves?

verses.kjv: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.modern: "Ah, sword of the LORD, how long before You rest? Return to Your scabbard. Cease and be still.

verses.kjv: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
verses.modern: But how can it rest when the LORD has commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the seacoast?"

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced judgment against the Philistines. Waters would rise out of the north as a flood and overflow the land. Fathers would not turn back for their children because of feebleness of hands. The LORD's sword would devour Ashkelon and the remnant of the coast, and there would be no rest for it.

verses.kjv: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.modern: Concerning Moab: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured. The stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.

verses.kjv: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be brought to silence, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.modern: Moab will be praised no more. In Heshbon people will plot her downfall: 'Come, let us put an end to that nation.' You too, Madmen, will be silenced. The sword will pursue You.

verses.kjv: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.modern: Listen to the cries from Horonaim — cries of great havoc and destruction.

verses.kjv: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.modern: Moab will be broken. Her little ones will cry out.

verses.kjv: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.modern: They go up the hill of Luhith, weeping bitterly as they go. On the road down to Horonaim anguished cries over the destruction are heard.

verses.kjv: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Flee! Run for Your lives! Become like a bush in the desert.

verses.kjv: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
verses.modern: Since You trust in Your deeds and riches, You too will be taken captive. Chemosh will go into exile, together with His priests and officials.

verses.kjv: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.modern: The destroyer will come against every town. Not one town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.modern: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste. Her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.modern: Cursed is the one who is lax in doing the LORD's work! Cursed is the one who keeps his sword from bloodshed!

verses.kjv: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.modern: "Moab has been at ease from her youth, settled like wine on its dregs, never poured from one jar to another — she has never gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.modern: But days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will send men who pour from jars, and they will pour her out. They will empty her jars and smash her jugs.

verses.kjv: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
verses.modern: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel was ashamed of Bethel, in which they trusted.

verses.kjv: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.modern: How can You say, 'We are warriors, men valiant in battle'?

verses.kjv: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Moab will be destroyed and her towns invaded. Her finest young men will go down in the slaughter," says the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.modern: "The fall of Moab is at hand. Her calamity will come quickly.

verses.kjv: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
verses.modern: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame. Say, 'How the mighty scepter is broken, that glorious staff!'

verses.kjv: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
verses.modern: Come down from Your glory and sit on the parched ground, You inhabitants of Daughter Dibon. For the one who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin Your fortified cities.

verses.kjv: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
verses.modern: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, 'What has happened?'

verses.kjv: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.modern: Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered. Wail and cry out! Announce by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.

verses.kjv: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.modern: Judgment has come to the plateau — to Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath,

verses.kjv: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
verses.modern: to Dibon, Nebo, and Beth Diblathaim,

verses.kjv: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,
verses.modern: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul, and Beth Meon,

verses.kjv: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.modern: to Kerioth and Bozrah — to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

verses.kjv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Moab's horn is cut off. Her arm is broken," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.modern: "Make her drunk, for she has defied the LORD. Let Moab wallow in her vomit. Let her be an object of ridicule.

verses.kjv: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
verses.modern: Was not Israel the object of Your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that You shake Your head in scorn whenever You speak of her?

verses.kjv: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
verses.modern: Abandon Your towns and dwell among the rocks, You who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.

verses.kjv: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.modern: We have heard of Moab's pride — her great pride — of her arrogance, her conceit, and the haughtiness of her heart.

verses.kjv: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
verses.modern: I know her insolence," says the LORD, "but her boasts are empty — her deeds amount to nothing.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.
verses.modern: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out. I moan for the people of Kir Hareseth.

verses.kjv: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
verses.modern: I weep for You, vine of Sibmah, more than I weep for Jazer. Your branches spread as far as the sea. They reached as far as Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on Your summer fruit and Your grape harvest.

verses.kjv: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.modern: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses. No one treads grapes with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.

verses.kjv: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.modern: The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz — from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah. Even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.modern: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
verses.modern: "So My heart laments for Moab like the music of a pipe. My heart laments like a pipe for the people of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.

verses.kjv: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.modern: Every head is shaved and every beard cut off. Every hand is slashed and every waist is covered with sackcloth.

verses.kjv: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: On all the rooftops in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning. For I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.modern: "How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.

verses.kjv: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.modern: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab's warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
verses.modern: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because she defied the LORD.

verses.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Terror and pit and snare await You, people of Moab," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit. Whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. For I will bring on Moab the year of her punishment," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.modern: In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon — a blaze from the midst of Sihon. It burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.

verses.kjv: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.modern: Woe to You, Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed. Your sons are taken into exile and Your daughters into captivity.

verses.kjv: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.modern: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come," says the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced an extensive judgment against Moab. Every city would be destroyed, and Moab's horn was cut off. Moab had been at ease from his youth and trusted in his works and treasures, but Chemosh his god would go into captivity. The LORD declared woe upon Moab for the destroyer had come upon every city, yet He would bring back the captives of Moab in the latter days.

verses.kjv: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.modern: Concerning the Ammonites: Thus says the LORD: "Has Israel no sons? Has He no heir? Why then does their king inherit Gad, and His people dwell in His cities?

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But the days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites. It will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.modern: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled! Cry, daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and lament. Run to and fro by the hedges, for their king shall go into captivity, and His priests and His princes together.

verses.kjv: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.modern: Why do You boast of Your valleys, boast of Your flowing valleys, unfaithful daughter? You trust in Your riches and say, 'Who will attack me?'

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.modern: I will bring terror on You from all those around You," says the Lord GOD of hosts. "Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.

verses.kjv: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.modern: Concerning Edom: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

verses.kjv: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.modern: Turn and flee! Hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan! For I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.

verses.kjv: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.modern: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?

verses.kjv: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.modern: But I will strip Esau bare. I will uncover his hiding places so that he cannot conceal himself. His children, relatives, and neighbors will perish, and he will be no more.

verses.kjv: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.modern: Leave your fatherless children. I will keep them alive. Your widows too can trust in Me."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken it; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should You go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.

verses.kjv: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.modern: I swear by Myself," says the LORD, "that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and disgrace. And all its towns will be in ruins forever."

verses.kjv: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the nations, saying, Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.modern: I have heard a message from the LORD. An envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!"

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.modern: "Now I will make You small among the nations, despised by mankind.

verses.kjv: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The terror You inspire and the pride of Your heart have deceived You, You who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though You build Your nest as high as the eagle's, from there I will bring You down," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.modern: "Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

verses.kjv: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.modern: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns," says the LORD, "so no one will live there. No person will dwell in it.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.modern: Like a lion coming up from Jordan's thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like Me and who can challenge Me? And what shepherd can stand against Me?"

verses.kjv: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.modern: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Edom, what He has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away. He will completely destroy their pasture because of them.

verses.kjv: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.modern: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble. Their cry will resound to the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.modern: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom's warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.modern: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened. There is anguish and sorrow, like the churning sea that cannot rest.

verses.kjv: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.modern: Damascus has become feeble. She has turned to flee and panic has gripped her. Anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.modern: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?

verses.kjv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets. All her soldiers will be silenced in that day," says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.modern: "I will set fire to the walls of Damascus. It will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad."

verses.kjv: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.modern: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the LORD says: "Rise up! Advance against Kedar! Destroy the people of the East!

verses.kjv: Their tents and their flocks shall be taken away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.modern: Their tents and their flocks will be taken. Their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. People will shout to them, 'Terror on every side!'

verses.kjv: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.modern: Flee quickly! Stay in deep caves, You who live in Hazor," says the LORD. "For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against You and formed a plan to destroy You.

verses.kjv: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.modern: Rise up! Attack a nation at ease, that lives in confidence," says the LORD, "a nation that has neither gates nor bars. Its people live alone.

verses.kjv: And their camels shall be for a booty, and the multitude of their cattle for a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoils of war. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.modern: Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there. No people will settle in it."

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.modern: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: 'See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.

verses.kjv: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.modern: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the heavens. I will scatter them to all these winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam's exiles do not go.

verses.kjv: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.modern: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster on them, even My fierce anger,' says the LORD. 'I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.

verses.kjv: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will set My throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials,' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Yet in days to come I will restore the fortunes of Elam,' says the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced judgment against Ammon for seizing the territory of Gad, against Edom for her pride in the clefts of the rock, against Damascus whose young men would fall in her streets, against Kedar and Hazor whom Nebuchadnezzar would strike, and against Elam whose bow the LORD would break. Yet the LORD would restore the fortunes of Ammon and Elam in the latter days.

verses.kjv: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.modern: This is the word the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians:

verses.kjv: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.modern: "Announce and proclaim among the nations. Lift up a banner and proclaim it. Keep nothing back but say, 'Babylon will be captured. Bel will be put to shame. Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.'

verses.kjv: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.modern: A nation from the north will attack her and lay waste her land. No one will live in it. Both people and animals will flee away.

verses.kjv: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
verses.modern: "In those days, at that time," says the LORD, "the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.modern: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.

verses.kjv: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.modern: "My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray. They have wandered over mountain and hill and forgotten their resting place.

verses.kjv: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
verses.modern: Whoever found them devoured them. Their enemies said, 'We are not guilty, for they sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their ancestors.'

verses.kjv: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.modern: Flee out of Babylon! Leave the land of the Babylonians and be like the goats that lead the flock.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.modern: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: So Babylonia will be plundered. All who plunder her will have their fill," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.modern: "Because You rejoice and are glad, You who pillage My inheritance — because You frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions —

verses.kjv: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.modern: your mother will be greatly ashamed. She who gave You birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations — a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.

verses.kjv: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.modern: Because of the LORD's anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be horrified and scoff because of all her wounds.

verses.kjv: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
verses.modern: "Take up Your positions around Babylon, all You who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.modern: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders. Her towers fall. Her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take vengeance on her. Do to her as she has done to others.

verses.kjv: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.modern: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with His sickle at harvest. Because of the oppressor's sword, each will return to their own people. Each will flee to their own land.

verses.kjv: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.modern: "Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour them was the king of Assyria. The last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.modern: But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture, and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan. Their appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.kjv: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.modern: In those days, at that time," says the LORD, "search will be made for Israel's iniquity, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.

verses.kjv: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.modern: "Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill, and completely destroy them," says the LORD. "Do everything I have commanded You.

verses.kjv: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.modern: The noise of battle is in the land — the noise of great destruction!

verses.kjv: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.modern: How broken and shattered is the hammer of the whole earth! How desolate is Babylon among the nations!

verses.kjv: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
verses.modern: I set a trap for You, Babylon, and You were caught before You knew it. You were found and captured because You opposed the LORD.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.modern: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out the weapons of His wrath, for the Sovereign LORD of hosts has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.modern: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries. Pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave no remnant.

verses.kjv: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.modern: Kill all her young bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come — the time of their punishment.

verses.kjv: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.modern: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon declaring in Zion how the LORD our God has taken His revenge, revenge for His temple.

verses.kjv: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her. Let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds. Do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets. All her soldiers will be silenced in that day," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
verses.modern: "See, I am against You, arrogant one," says the Lord GOD of hosts. "For Your day has come — the time for You to be punished.

verses.kjv: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.modern: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up. I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.

verses.kjv: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.modern: Yet their Redeemer is strong. The LORD of hosts is His name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that He may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.

verses.kjv: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.modern: "A sword against the Babylonians!" says the LORD — "against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!

verses.kjv: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.modern: A sword against her false prophets! They will become fools. A sword against her warriors! They will be filled with terror.

verses.kjv: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.modern: A sword against her horses and chariots and all the foreigners in her ranks! They will become weaklings. A sword against her treasures! They will be plundered.

verses.kjv: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.modern: A drought on her waters! They will dry up. For it is a land of idols — idols that will go mad with terror.

verses.kjv: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.modern: So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.

verses.kjv: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.modern: As I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns," says the LORD, "so no one will live there. No people will settle in it.

verses.kjv: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.modern: Look! An army is coming from the north. A great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.modern: They are armed with bows and spears. They are cruel and without mercy. Their sound is like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses. They come in battle formation — arrayed as one man — against You, Daughter Babylon.

verses.kjv: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.modern: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.modern: Like a lion coming up from Jordan's thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Babylon from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like Me and who can challenge Me? And what shepherd can stand against Me?

verses.kjv: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.modern: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Babylon, what He has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away. Their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

verses.kjv: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.modern: At the sound of Babylon's capture the earth will tremble. Its cry will resound among the nations.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounced judgment against Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans. Babylon would be taken, Bel put to shame, and Merodach broken in pieces. Israel and Judah would seek the LORD with weeping and ask the way to Zion. The LORD would raise up an assembly of great nations from the north against Babylon, and she would become a desolation -- as she did to others, so it would be done to her.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and against those who live in Leb Kamai.

verses.kjv: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.modern: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land. They will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.

verses.kjv: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.modern: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let Him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men. Completely destroy her army.

verses.kjv: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.modern: They will fall down slain in Babylon, fatally wounded in her streets.

verses.kjv: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the LORD of hosts, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompense.
verses.modern: Flee from Babylon! Run for Your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the LORD's vengeance. He will repay her what she deserves.

verses.kjv: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.modern: Babylon was a gold cup in the LORD's hand. She made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine. Therefore they have now gone mad.

verses.kjv: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.modern: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain — perhaps she can be healed.

verses.kjv: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.modern: 'We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed. Let us leave her and each go to our own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies. It rises as high as the heavens.'

verses.kjv: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
verses.modern: The LORD has vindicated us. Come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has done.

verses.kjv: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.modern: "Sharpen the arrows! Take up the shields! The LORD has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because His purpose is to destroy Babylon. The LORD will take vengeance — vengeance for His temple.

verses.kjv: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.modern: Lift up a banner against the walls of Babylon! Reinforce the guard. Station the watchmen. Prepare an ambush! The LORD will carry out His purpose, His decree against the people of Babylon.

verses.kjv: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.modern: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, Your end has come — the time for You to be cut off.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts has sworn by Himself: I will fill You with troops, as with a swarm of locusts. They will shout in triumph over You.

verses.kjv: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.modern: "He made the earth by His power. He founded the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

verses.kjv: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.modern: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar. He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from His storehouses.

verses.kjv: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.modern: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is shamed by His idols. His images are a fraud — they have no breath in them.

verses.kjv: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.modern: They are worthless, the objects of mockery. When their judgment comes, they will perish.

verses.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.modern: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things — including the people of his inheritance. The LORD of hosts is His name.

verses.kjv: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.modern: "You are My war club, My weapon for battle — with You I shatter nations. With You I destroy kingdoms.

verses.kjv: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.modern: With You I shatter horse and rider. With You I shatter chariot and driver.

verses.kjv: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.modern: With You I shatter man and woman. With You I shatter old man and youth. With You I shatter young man and young woman.

verses.kjv: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.modern: With You I shatter shepherd and flock. With You I shatter farmer and oxen. With You I shatter governors and officials.

verses.kjv: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.modern: "I am against You, destroying mountain, You who destroy the whole earth," says the LORD. "I will stretch out My hand against You, roll You off the cliffs, and make You a burned-out mountain.

verses.kjv: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: No rock will be taken from You for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for You will be desolate forever," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.modern: "Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her. Summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her. Send up horses like a swarm of locusts.

verses.kjv: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.modern: Prepare the nations for battle against her — the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.

verses.kjv: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: The land trembles and writhes, for the LORD's purposes against Babylon stand — to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.

verses.kjv: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.modern: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting. They remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted. They have become like women. Her dwellings are set on fire. The bars of her gates are broken.

verses.kjv: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
verses.modern: One courier follows another. Messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,

verses.kjv: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.modern: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled. The time to harvest her will soon come."

verses.kjv: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.modern: "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion. He has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.

verses.kjv: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.modern: May the violence done to our flesh be on Babylon," say the inhabitants of Zion. "May our blood be on those who live in Babylonia," says Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "See, I will defend Your cause and take vengeance for You. I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.

verses.kjv: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.modern: Babylon will become a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.

verses.kjv: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
verses.modern: Her people all roar like young lions. They growl like lion cubs.

verses.kjv: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter — then sleep forever and not wake," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.modern: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.

verses.kjv: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.modern: How Sheshach will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! What a horror Babylon will be among the nations!

verses.kjv: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of his waves.
verses.modern: The sea will rise over Babylon. Its roaring waves will cover her.

verses.kjv: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.modern: Her towns will be desolate, a dry and desert land — a land where no one lives and through which no one travels.

verses.kjv: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.modern: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make Him spew out what He has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.

verses.kjv: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.modern: Come out of her, My people! Run for Your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.modern: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land. One rumor comes this year, another the next — rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.modern: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon. Her whole land will be disgraced and all her slain will fall within her.

verses.kjv: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.modern: Babylon must fall because of Israel's slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.modern: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the LORD in a distant land and call Jerusalem to mind.

verses.kjv: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD's house.
verses.modern: "We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD's house."

verses.kjv: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.modern: "But days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.

verses.kjv: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Even if Babylon reaches the sky and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.modern: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon — the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.modern: The LORD is destroying Babylon. He will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters. The roar of their voices will resound,

verses.kjv: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.modern: for a destroyer will come against Babylon. Her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the LORD is a God of retribution. He will repay in full.

verses.kjv: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers, and warriors as well. They will sleep forever and not wake," says the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Babylon's thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire. The peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations' labor is only fuel for the flames."

verses.kjv: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.modern: This is the message Jeremiah gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when He went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.kjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.modern: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon — all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.modern: He said to Seraiah, "When You get to Babylon, see that You read all these words aloud.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.modern: Then say, 'LORD, You have said You will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it. It will be desolate forever.'

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.modern: When You finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.modern: Then say, 'So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.'" The words of Jeremiah end here.

chapters.summary: The LORD declared He would raise up a destroying wind against Babylon and send fanners to fan her. Babylon was a golden cup in the LORD's hand that made all the earth drunk, but now she was suddenly fallen and broken. The LORD commanded His people to flee out of her midst. Jeremiah wrote all the coming disaster on a scroll and sent it to Babylon with Seraiah, commanding him to tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates as a sign that Babylon would sink and never rise again.

verses.kjv: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.modern: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah. She was from Libnah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.modern: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.

verses.kjv: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.modern: It was because of the LORD's anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end He thrust them from His presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.modern: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They camped outside the city and built siege works all around it.

verses.kjv: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.modern: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.kjv: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.modern: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people.

verses.kjv: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.modern: Then the city wall was broken through. Although the Babylonians had surrounded the city, all the soldiers fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden. They fled toward the Arabah.

verses.kjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.modern: But the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered.

verses.kjv: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.modern: He was captured and taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

verses.kjv: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.modern: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the officials of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.modern: Then he put out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon where he put him in prison till the day of his death.

verses.kjv: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
verses.modern: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
verses.modern: He set fire to the temple of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building He burned down.

verses.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.modern: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
verses.modern: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had gone over to the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.modern: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

verses.kjv: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.modern: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands, and the bronze Sea that were in the temple of the LORD and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.

verses.kjv: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.modern: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes, and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

verses.kjv: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.modern: The commander of the imperial guard took away the basins, censers, sprinkling bowls, pots, lampstands, dishes, and bowls used for drink offerings — whatever was made of pure gold or silver.

verses.kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.modern: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea, and the twelve bronze bulls under it, and the movable stands, which King Solomon had made for the temple of the LORD — all these could not be weighed.

verses.kjv: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
verses.modern: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference. Each was four fingers thick and hollow.
